spells.name: Abi-dalzim's Horrid Wilting
spells.description: You rip every drop of moisture from every creature in a 30-foot cube, dealing 12d8 necrotic damage on a failed Constitution save or half on a success. Plants and water elementals wither catastrophically, saving at disadvantage and taking maximum damage.

spells.name: Absorb Elements
spells.description: Cast in reaction to taking acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage: you halve that damage, and your next melee attack before the end of your next turn deals an extra 1d6 damage of the same type.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.description: A stinging bubble of acid bursts over one creature, or two creatures standing within 5 feet of each other. Each target makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 acid damage, and the damage grows as you reach higher levels.

spells.name: Aganazzar's Scorcher
spells.description: A line of roaring flame 30 feet long and 5 feet wide blazes from you. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d8 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Each higher slot adds 1d8.

spells.name: Agni's Looming Inferno
spells.description: Flame tendrils gather on a creature you can see in range, applying one flame charge. Once on each of your turns you may use an action or bonus action to add a charge to a creature that already has at least one charge and is in range. When the spell ends, the creature takes fire damage by charges held: 1 charge 1d6, 2 charges 3d6, 3 charges 6d6, 4 charges 10d6, 5 charges 15d6, 6 charges 21d6, 7 charges 28d6, 8 charges 36d6, 9 charges 45d6, 10 charges 55d6. Material component: a short sword and a thread.

spells.name: Aid
spells.description: Your blessing bolsters up to three creatures: each one's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for 8 hours. Each higher slot raises the bonus by 5. Druids gained this spell in 2024.

spells.name: Air Bubble
spells.description: From Spelljammer: a spectral bubble of fresh air surrounds a willing creature's head for 24 hours, letting it breathe anywhere — even in the airless void between worlds or deep underwater. Each higher slot bubbles one more creature.

spells.name: Alarm
spells.description: You ward a door, window, or 20-foot cube for 8 hours. When a creature you have not designated enters the area, the spell alerts you with a mental ping if you are awake, or a ringing bell if you are asleep.

spells.name: Alter Self
spells.description: You reshape your own body while you concentrate: breathe and swim underwater, alter your appearance (though not your size or shape), or grow natural weapons — claws, fangs, horns — that strike as unarmed attacks with a magical edge. You can switch the option as an action.

spells.name: Animal Friendship
spells.description: A beast with low Intelligence makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for 24 hours. If you or your allies harm it, the spell ends; upcasting lets you befriend one additional beast per level.

spells.name: Animal Messenger
spells.description: You charm a Tiny beast into carrying a spoken message of up to 25 words to a recipient you describe at a place you name. It travels for up to 24 hours (longer with higher slots), delivers the message, and returns if you wish.

spells.name: Animal Shapes
spells.description: The forest answers your call: any number of willing creatures you can see become beasts of your choosing (challenge rating 4 or lower), gaining the beast's hit points and senses. You can reshape them into new beasts again as an action for the whole day.

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.description: You imbue a corpse or pile of bones with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as a skeleton or zombie under your control for 24 hours. You command your undead with a bonus action, and recasting the spell reasserts control over up to four of them (more with a higher-level slot).

spells.name: Animate Objects
spells.description: Nonmagical objects sprout legs and come alive under your command, using a single Animated Object stat block (AC 15). You can animate a number of objects equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (Medium counts as one, Large as two, Huge as three), and each makes Slam attacks dealing force damage by size (1d4 + 3, 2d6 + 3 + modifier, or 2d12 + 3 + modifier); upcasting increases the Slam damage.

spells.name: Antagonize
spells.description: You hurl a magically needling insult with a flourish of a playing card. A creature that fails a Wisdom save takes 4d6 psychic damage and must spend its reaction making a melee attack against a creature of your choice; a success halves the sting and keeps its temper.

spells.name: Antilife Shell
spells.description: A shimmering 10-foot emanation hedges out living creatures: anything other than a Construct or an Undead cannot enter it, and the barrier moves with you, collapsing if you force it against a creature it would exclude.

spells.name: Antimagic Field
spells.description: A sphere of dead magic moves with you: spells fail inside it, magic items go mundane, summoned creatures wink out, and magical effects are suppressed at its border. Only artifacts and the works of deities resist its hush.

spells.name: Antipathy/sympathy
spells.description: You enchant an object or area to repel or lure a kind of creature you name. Antipathy fills such creatures with terror that drives them away; Sympathy draws them irresistibly toward the target, held by fascination while within its aura, each resisted by a Wisdom save.

spells.name: Arcane Eye
spells.description: An invisible magical eye hovers into being and reports everything it sees to you. As a bonus action you drift it up to 30 feet in any direction; its darkvision peers 30 feet in every direction, though solid barriers block it.

spells.name: Arcane Gate
spells.description: Two circular portals, 10 feet across, open on the ground and link two points you can see: anything entering one steps out of the other as if the two were adjacent. As a bonus action you can rotate either portal to face a new direction.

spells.name: Arcane Lock
spells.description: A door, window, chest, or other entryway you touch becomes magically locked and far harder to break or pick (+10 to the relevant DCs). You and creatures you designate — or anyone speaking a password you set — can pass freely.

spells.name: Arcane Vigor
spells.description: A new 2024 spell for emergencies: as a bonus action you spend some of your own vitality, rolling up to half your Hit Dice and regaining hit points equal to the total plus your spellcasting modifier.

spells.name: Arcing Arrow
spells.description: As part of casting you make a ranged weapon attack against a creature in range, or the spell fails. On a hit the attack deals its normal effects; on a miss you choose a second creature in range and attack it with the same weapon, and on a hit that creature takes lightning damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. At 5th level the attack deals an extra 1d8 lightning damage, rising to 2d8 at 11th and 3d8 at 17th.

spells.name: Armor Of Agathys
spells.description: Spectral frost armors you: you gain 5 temporary hit points, and while any of them remain, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage. Both amounts rise by 5 per slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Arms Of Hadar
spells.description: Shadowy tendrils erupt from you in every direction. Each other creature within 10 feet makes a Strength save, taking 2d6 necrotic damage and losing its reaction on a failure, or half damage on a success.

spells.name: Ashardalon's Stride
spells.description: Dragon-flame blasts from your feet: your speed rises by 20 feet, your movement provokes no opportunity attacks, and anything you pass within 5 feet of is scorched for 1d6 fire damage, once per turn. Higher slots add speed and fire alike.

spells.name: Aspir
spells.description: You drain the mystical energy of a spellcasting creature you can see. It must succeed on an Intelligence save or lose a 1st-level spell slot if it has one; if it does, you regain an expended 1st-level slot. At higher levels it loses its highest slot up to the slot you expended, and you regain a slot of the level it lost. Material component: a blue ribbon.

spells.name: Astral Projection
spells.description: You and up to eight companions project your spirits into the Astral Plane, leaving your bodies sleeping and untouchable by time or hunger, joined to your astral forms by silver cords. From the Astral Sea you can step through colored pools to any other plane, and return by dismissing the spell.

spells.name: Augury
spells.description: You cast sticks, bones, or cards and receive an omen — weal, woe, weal-and-woe, or nothing — about a course of action planned within the next 30 minutes. Repeat castings within a day grow unreliable. Druids and wizards gained this spell in 2024.

spells.name: Aura Of Life
spells.description: A preserving radiance surrounds you in a 30-foot emanation: allies within resist necrotic damage, their hit point maximums cannot be reduced, and any ally who starts a turn at 0 hit points rises with 1 instead.

spells.name: Aura Of Purity
spells.description: A cleansing aura extends 30 feet around you. Allies within resist poison damage and roll with advantage against effects that would blind, charm, deafen, frighten, paralyze, poison, or stun them.

spells.name: Aura Of Vitality
spells.description: Healing energy radiates from you in a 30-foot emanation. When the aura appears and at the start of each of your turns, you may restore 2d6 hit points to one creature within it.

spells.name: Awaken
spells.description: After tracing runes around an agate, you grant a Beast or Plant with Intelligence 3 or less true sentience: Intelligence 10, the ability to speak a language you know, and keen senses. A plant gains the ability to move and manipulate its limbs, and an awakened Beast is Charmed by you for 30 days or until you or your allies harm it.

spells.name: Backlash
spells.description: When damage finds you, you ward it off and answer in kind: reduce the damage taken by 4d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier, and if the creature that hurt you is within 60 feet, force it to make a Constitution save or take 4d6 force damage, half on a success.

spells.name: Bane
spells.description: Up to three creatures make Charisma saves; each that fails subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls and saving throws for the duration. Upcasting adds one more target per level.

spells.name: Banishing Smite
spells.description: Cast as a bonus action right after you hit with a weapon: the target takes an extra 5d10 force damage, and if it has 50 hit points or fewer it makes a Charisma save or is banished to a harmless demiplane. Numbers flagged for Zach's physical PHB check (approved Hexblade ruling 2026-11-03).

spells.name: Banishment
spells.description: You hurl a creature to a harmless demiplane on a failed Charisma save, where it sits incapacitated until the spell ends. A creature native to another plane is sent home for good if you hold the spell the full minute; higher slots banish additional targets.

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.description: Reworked in 2024: a quick bonus action with no concentration — the touched creature's skin becomes bark-like and its AC is 17 if it would otherwise be lower, lasting an hour.

spells.name: Beacon Of Hope
spells.description: You fill any number of creatures you choose with hope and vigor: each has advantage on Wisdom and death saving throws, and every die rolled to heal them counts as its maximum.

spells.name: Beast Bond
spells.description: You forge a telepathic link with a friendly beast you touch, communicating simple ideas while you concentrate. The beast also gains advantage on attacks against any creature within 5 feet of you.

spells.name: Beast Sense
spells.description: You touch a willing beast and, while you concentrate, see and hear through its senses instead of your own — a ritual scout that goes where you cannot.

spells.name: Befuddlement
spells.description: The 2024 reworking of Feeblemind: a psychic blast that deals 10d12 psychic damage on a failed Intelligence save (half on a success) and, on a failure, leaves the victim unable to cast spells or take Magic actions for 30 days, when the save can be repeated. Heal, Greater Restoration, or Wish ends it sooner.

spells.name: Bestow Curse
spells.description: Your touch curses a creature that fails a Wisdom save: choose to blight one ability score, hinder its attacks against you, make it risk wasting its actions, or make your attacks and spells deal it an extra 1d8 necrotic damage. Higher slots stretch the curse to hours, and a 5th-level slot needs no concentration.

spells.name: Bigby's Hand
spells.description: You conjure a Large hand of shimmering energy (AC 20, hit points equal to your maximum) that you direct as a bonus action. Its Clenched Fist makes a melee spell attack for 5d8 force damage, its Forceful Hand shoves a creature that fails a Strength save, its Grasping Hand grapples on a failed Dexterity save and can crush for 4d6 + your modifier bludgeoning damage, and its Interposing Hand grants you cover.

spells.name: Blade Barrier
spells.description: A wall of whirling blades made of magical energy appears — a straight wall up to 100 feet long and 20 feet high, or a ring 60 feet across — granting three-quarters cover and counting as difficult terrain. A creature in the wall when it appears, or that enters it or ends its turn there, makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d10 force damage on a failure or half on a success, once per turn at most.

spells.name: Blade Of Disaster
spells.description: A rift in reality shaped like a black blade hangs in the air, slicing through any barrier — even a wall of force. As a bonus action you move it and make two melee spell attacks with it, each dealing 4d12 force damage, with critical hits on a roll of 18 or higher dealing devastating extra damage.

spells.name: Blade Ward
spells.description: In the 2024 revision this ward no longer grants resistance; instead, while you concentrate, every attack roll made against you is reduced by 1d4, blunting incoming blows before they land.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: You bless up to three creatures. Whenever a blessed creature makes an attack roll or saving throw before the spell ends, it adds 1d4 to the roll. Upcasting adds one more target per level.

spells.name: Blight
spells.description: Necromantic energy withers a creature from within: it makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Plant creatures and vegetation gain no such mercy — they save at disadvantage and take maximum damage.

spells.name: Blinding Smite
spells.description: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell, the attack deals an extra 3d8 radiant damage and the target must make a Constitution save or be blinded until the spell ends. Higher slots add 1d8 per slot level above 3rd. (Casting details from PHB 2014 standard text — verify before merge.)

spells.name: Blindness/deafness
spells.description: You rob one creature of a sense: Constitution save or it is blinded or deafened (your choice) for a minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Each higher slot afflicts one more creature.

spells.name: Blink
spells.description: You flicker between planes for a minute: at the end of each of your turns, roll a d20 — on an 11 or higher you vanish to the Ethereal Plane until your next turn, then reappear within 10 feet of where you vanished.

spells.name: Bloodletting Bite
spells.description: As part of casting you make a weapon attack against a creature in range, or the spell fails. On a hit, if the creature is above half its hit point maximum it suffers only the attack's normal effects; if it is at or below half, it also takes 1d12 necrotic damage. The extra damage rises to 2d12 at 5th level, 3d12 at 11th, 4d12 at 17th. Material component: a weapon.

spells.name: Blur
spells.description: Your outline blurs and wavers, impossible to pin down: attack rolls against you have disadvantage while you concentrate, unless the attacker can see through illusions or does not rely on sight.

spells.name: Bones Of The Earth
spells.description: Up to six pillars of stone, 5 feet across and up to 30 feet tall, burst from the ground; each has AC 5 and 30 hit points and crumbles into difficult-terrain rubble when destroyed. A creature under a rising pillar makes a Dexterity save or is lifted with it — and if a ceiling stops the pillar short, the creature takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is Restrained, pinned between stone and obstacle. Upcasting adds two pillars per level.

spells.name: Booming Blade
spells.description: As part of casting you make a melee weapon attack; the target is sheathed in booming energy until your next turn, and if it willingly moves it takes 1d8 thunder damage. At 5th level the attack itself also deals extra thunder damage, and both rolls scale.

spells.name: Borrowed Knowledge
spells.description: From Strixhaven's libraries: you draw on the collected knowledge of the ages and gain proficiency in one skill of your choice for an hour.

spells.name: Branding Smite
spells.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack during the spell, the attack deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage, and the target sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius and cannot benefit from invisibility until the spell ends. Higher slots add 1d6 per slot level above 2nd. (Casting details from PHB 2014 standard text — verify before merge.)

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: A sheet of flame roars from your outstretched fingers. Each creature in the 15-foot cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success, and unattended flammables ignite.

spells.name: Cacophonic Shield
spells.description: Thunderous reverberations fill a 10-foot emanation around you. Creatures caught in it (except those you spare) make a Constitution save when it reaches them or they end their turn inside, taking 3d6 thunder damage and being deafened on a failure or half damage on a success; meanwhile thunder rolls off you harmlessly and ranged attacks against you falter.

spells.name: Call Lightning
spells.description: A storm cloud crackles overhead and you call down bolts of lightning: each creature within 5 feet of a point you choose makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d10 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. You can call another bolt as an action on later turns, and a real storm overhead makes each bolt stronger.

spells.name: Calm Emotions
spells.description: You settle a crowd's spirit: each humanoid in a 20-foot sphere makes a Charisma save or has any charm or fright effect on it suppressed, or is made indifferent to creatures it was hostile toward (unless attacked).

spells.name: Catapult
spells.description: One loose object of 1 to 5 pounds flies in a line you choose up to 90 feet. The first creature or surface in its path makes a Dexterity save or takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage as the object slams home; heavier objects and more damage come with higher slots.

spells.name: Catnap
spells.description: Up to three willing creatures drift off into a magical slumber for 10 minutes; an unwilling target resists with a Wisdom save. Any who sleep the whole span wake with the benefits of a short rest — though the trick works on a creature only once per long rest.

spells.name: Cause Fear
spells.description: You awaken the sense of mortality in one creature, which makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Upcasting terrifies one additional creature per level.

spells.name: Ceremony
spells.description: You perform a religious rite — a wedding, funeral, coming of age, dedication, or atonement — with a small real blessing attached, such as a married couple gaining +2 AC while near each other for a week, or holy water consecrated by the rite.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.description: A bolt of lightning arcs to a target you can see, then leaps to up to three other targets within 30 feet of the first. Each target makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d8 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success; each higher-level slot adds one more leaping bolt.

spells.name: Chaos Bolt
spells.description: A twisting mass of chaotic energy: ranged spell attack for 2d8 + 1d6 damage, where the d8s rolled decide the damage type (acid through thunder). If the d8s come up doubles, the bolt leaps to another target within 30 feet and attacks again.

spells.name: Charm Monster
spells.description: Any creature — beast, monstrosity, or worse — that fails a Wisdom save is charmed by you for the hour, friendly and cooperative short of harm to itself. Fighting you or your companions grants it advantage on the save, and higher slots charm more monsters.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.description: A humanoid makes a Wisdom save (with advantage if you are fighting it) or is charmed for an hour, regarding you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends it knows it was charmed; upcasting targets one more humanoid per level.

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.description: A skeletal hand of grave-cold energy closes on a creature you touch with a melee spell attack, dealing 1d10 necrotic damage. The chill lingers: the target cannot regain hit points until the end of your next turn, and undead also have disadvantage on attacks against you.

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.description: You hurl a 4-inch sphere of energy with a ranged spell attack for 3d8 damage of a type you choose (acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder). In 2024, if two or more damage dice show the same number, the orb leaps to another creature nearby.

spells.name: Circle Of Death
spells.description: Negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius sphere from a point you choose. Each creature in the area makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success; each higher-level slot adds 2d8 damage.

spells.name: Circle Of Power
spells.description: Divine energy radiates from you in a 30-foot emanation that moves with you. Allies within it have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and when such an effect allows a successful save to take only half damage, an ally that succeeds takes no damage instead.

spells.name: Clairvoyance
spells.description: You create an invisible sensor at a familiar location within a mile, and see or hear through it as if you were there, switching senses as an action. The sensor is immobile but reveals a room as surely as standing in it.

spells.name: Clone
spells.description: From a cubic inch of the subject's flesh you grow an inert duplicate body in a sealed vessel over 120 days. If the original dies while the clone is mature, its soul transfers into the clone and wakes in the new body — even, if you wish, a younger one.

spells.name: Cloud Of Daggers
spells.description: A glittering storm of spinning daggers fills a 5-foot cube: a creature takes 4d4 slashing damage when it enters the cube or starts its turn there — no save — and in 2024 you can move the cloud 30 feet as a Magic action. Each higher slot adds 2d4.

spells.name: Cloudkill
spells.description: Yellowish-green poison fog fills a 20-foot-radius sphere, heavily obscuring it and rolling 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns, sinking around corners and through openings. Creatures in it when it appears, when they first enter it on a turn, or when they end their turn there make a Constitution save, taking 5d8 poison damage on a failure or half on a success.

spells.name: Color Spray
spells.description: A dazzling array of flashing color sprays from your hand. In 2024 the hit-point pool is gone: every creature in the 15-foot cone simply makes a Constitution save or is blinded until the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Command
spells.description: You speak a one-word command — Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt — to a creature that makes a Wisdom save or obeys on its next turn. Upcasting commands one additional creature per level.

spells.name: Commune
spells.description: You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no, receiving a correct answer (or an unclear one if the being does not know). Casting it again before a long rest risks a garbled or random reading.

spells.name: Commune With Nature
spells.description: You briefly merge with nature and learn up to three facts about the surrounding terrain (a 3-mile radius outdoors, or 300 feet underground): the lay of the land, prevalent plants, minerals or animals, powerful magical beings, influential planar forces, or settlements and structures.

spells.name: Compelled Duel
spells.description: You compel a creature that fails a Wisdom save to face you alone: it has disadvantage on attacks against anyone else and must save again to willingly move away from you, and the spell ends if you attack another creature or if an ally harms your foe.

spells.name: Comprehend Languages
spells.description: For an hour you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language you hear and can read any written language you touch, though decoding secret writing and ciphers is beyond it.

spells.name: Compulsion
spells.description: Creatures of your choice that can hear you and fail a Wisdom save become puppets of your direction: each turn you designate a direction with a bonus action, and they must spend as much of their movement as possible marching that way, saving again after each march. Only an obviously deadly hazard gives them pause.

spells.name: Cone Of Cold
spells.description: A blast of freezing air erupts from your hands in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 cold damage on a failure or half on a success, and a creature killed by the blast becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.

spells.name: Confusion
spells.description: Minds unravel in a 10-foot sphere: creatures that fail a Wisdom save cannot take bonus actions or reactions and roll each turn to see whether they babble, wander, or attack at random. The save repeats at the end of each turn, and higher slots widen the sphere.

spells.name: Conjure Animals
spells.description: Nature spirits gather as a Large pack of spectral animals — wolves, serpents, or birds — that you can move 30 feet whenever you move. Any creature the pack closes with, or that enters or ends its turn within 10 feet of it, makes a Dexterity save or takes 3d10 slashing damage, once per turn.

spells.name: Conjure Barrage
spells.description: You brandish a weapon and a volley of its spectral duplicates streaks out in a 60-foot cone. Each creature of your choice in the cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d8 force damage on a failure or half on a success.

spells.name: Conjure Celestial
spells.description: A spirit of the Upper Planes descends as a pillar of radiant light, a cylinder 10 feet wide and 40 feet tall that you can steer as you move. Each creature caught in its glow is bathed in healing light (4d12 + your modifier) or searing light (6d12 radiant damage on a failed Dexterity save, half on a success), once per turn.

spells.name: Conjure Constructs
spells.description: Orderly spirits appear as a hovering knot of modrons that drifts along as you move. When you cast the spell and as an action on later turns, you direct them to strike a nearby foe — a Dexterity save against 3d6 force damage, half on a success — or to grant an ally temporary hit points instead.

spells.name: Conjure Elemental
spells.description: You conjure an intangible Large elemental spirit of air (lightning), earth (thunder), fire (fire), or water (cold). While it holds no creature Restrained, a creature that enters its space or starts its turn within 5 feet of it makes a Dexterity save or takes 8d8 damage of the chosen type and is Restrained; a restrained creature repeats the save at the start of each of its turns, taking 4d8 damage on a failure and breaking free on a success.

spells.name: Conjure Fey
spells.description: You conjure a Medium spirit from the Feywild in the shape of a Fey creature. When it appears — and as a bonus action on later turns, teleporting it up to 30 feet — you make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it: on a hit the target takes 3d12 + your spellcasting ability modifier psychic damage and has the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn. Upcasting adds 2d12 damage.

spells.name: Conjure Minor Elementals
spells.description: Elemental spirits swirl around you in a 15-foot emanation that is difficult terrain for your enemies. Every attack you land on a creature inside it deals an extra 2d8 damage — acid, cold, fire, or lightning, chosen with each blow. (Upcast scaling uses the current errata value.)

spells.name: Conjure Volley
spells.description: You fire a piece of ammunition or throw a weapon skyward and a rain of spectral copies falls in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d8 piercing damage on a failure or half on a success.

spells.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
spells.description: Nature spirits dance around you in a 10-foot emanation. A creature that enters it or ends its turn there makes a Wisdom save or takes 5d8 force damage, and while the spirits surround you, you can Disengage as a bonus action.

spells.name: Consumptive Field
spells.description: A consumptive death field radiates from you in a 15-foot aura that moves with you. When a hostile creature enters the aura for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution save; on a failure it takes 2d6 necrotic damage and you regain hit points equal to half the damage dealt. Undead are unaffected. Higher slots add 1d6 per slot level above 4th.

spells.name: Contact Other Plane
spells.description: You reach across the planes to a demigod, dead sage, or stranger entity. Make an Intelligence save when you cast it: on a failure you take 6d6 psychic damage and are driven mad until a long rest, but on a success you can ask five questions, answered in single words (or short phrases when a word would mislead).

spells.name: Contagion
spells.description: Your touch seeds a magical contagion. The target makes a Constitution save or takes 11d8 necrotic damage and gains the Poisoned condition, and while poisoned it has disadvantage on saving throws with one ability you chose when casting. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns: three successes end the spell early, while three failures lock the contagion in for the full 7 days.

spells.name: Contingency
spells.description: You prepare for the worst: as part of casting this spell you also cast a spell of 5th level or lower that targets you, and describe a trigger. When the trigger first occurs, the stored spell takes effect on you and the contingency ends. Only one contingency can guard you at a time, and it ends if the gem-encrusted statuette of yourself leaves your person.

spells.name: Continual Flame
spells.description: A flame springs from an object you touch, shedding bright light like a torch but producing no heat and consuming no oxygen. It lasts until dispelled — a permanent lantern that rain cannot quench.

spells.name: Control Flames
spells.description: You manipulate an existing nonmagical flame: spread it, snuff it, double or halve its brightness, or shape simple images in it that last up to an hour.

spells.name: Control Water
spells.description: All freestanding water in a cube up to 100 feet on a side obeys you: raise a flood or a traveling wave, part it into a trench, redirect its flow uphill, or spin a ship-smashing whirlpool, changing the effect as an action on your turns.

spells.name: Control Weather
spells.description: You seize the sky for miles around, dictating precipitation, temperature, and wind — summoning storms, blizzards, or clear calm — shifting each condition gradually over the hours while you hold the working outdoors.

spells.name: Control Winds
spells.description: You seize control of the air in a 100-foot cube and set a wind pattern of your choice: Gusts that blow in a direction you set (creatures moving against them are slowed, and those caught in them make a Strength save or are pushed 15 feet), a Downdraft that halves falling damage and doubles jump distance, or an Updraft that cushions falls and aids leaps. You can change the pattern as an action.

spells.name: Cordon Of Arrows
spells.description: You plant four pieces of ammunition in the ground around you as a ward for 8 hours. When a creature other than you comes within 30 feet, an arrow flies at it: Dexterity save or 1d6 piercing damage. Each higher slot wards with two more arrows.

spells.name: Corpse Mask
spells.description: You touch a humanoid corpse and transform your physical appearance — clothing, armor, weapons, and belongings included — to look as the corpse did shortly before death, keeping your own abilities. You instinctively mimic its mannerisms; a creature familiar with the deceased may use its action to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to see through it. Higher slots extend the duration to 8 hours (3rd–4th) or 24 hours (5th+).

spells.name: Corrupted Ki Kata
spells.description: As part of casting you make an unarmed strike against a creature in range, or the spell fails. On a hit it suffers the attack's normal effects and its ki is corrupted until the end of your next turn; a creature with corrupted ki has disadvantage on saves against being poisoned, and if you hit it with this cantrip while corrupted it takes an extra 1d8 poison damage. At 5th level the strike deals an extra 1d8 poison and the corrupted-ki damage rises to 2d8, both rising by 1d8 again at 11th (2d8/3d8) and 17th (3d8/4d8).

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.description: When you see a creature within 60 feet casting a spell, you reach out to snuff the magic: the caster makes a Constitution saving throw, and on a failure its spell is countered and fizzles with no effect. On a success, the casting completes normally.

spells.name: Create Bonfire
spells.description: A bonfire fills a 5-foot cube on the ground. Any creature in its space when it appears, that enters it, or that ends its turn there makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 fire damage, scaling at higher levels.

spells.name: Create Food And Water
spells.description: You conjure 45 pounds of bland but nourishing food and 30 gallons of clean water on the ground or in containers — enough to stave off hunger and thirst for a company of travelers, though the food spoils after a day.

spells.name: Create Homunculus
spells.description: You sculpt a tiny winged homunculus from clay, ash, and mandrake root, quickening it with a vial of your own blood (which temporarily lessens your hit point maximum). The creature is your loyal servant and telepathic scout, sharing its senses with you across any distance on the same plane.

spells.name: Create Magen
spells.description: Through an hour of transmutation you give lasting life to a magen, a loyal humanoid servant built for a purpose — attendant, guard, or messenger — that serves you until destroyed. The creation saps your vitality, permanently reducing your hit point maximum for each magen while it exists.

spells.name: Create Or Destroy Water
spells.description: You create up to 10 gallons of clean water (as rain in a 30-foot cube, or in an open container) or destroy up to 10 gallons, and can also disperse fog in the area. The volume doubles with each higher slot.

spells.name: Create Spelljamming Helm
spells.description: Over a long working you transform an ordinary chair into a spelljamming helm: a seat that lets a spellcaster attuned to it propel and steer a ship through the Astral Sea and wildspace, channeling their magic into flight.

spells.name: Create Undead
spells.description: Only at night, you raise up to three corpses of Medium or Small Humanoids as ghouls under your control for 24 hours; recasting reasserts control instead of animating anew. Higher-level slots animate more ghouls, or more powerful undead — ghasts, wights, and even mummies.

spells.name: Creation
spells.description: You pull strands of shadow-stuff from the Shadowfell and weave them into a nonmagical object of vegetable matter in a space up to a 5-foot cube. The creation lasts from 10 minutes to a full day depending on the material mimicked, and can serve as the material component for another casting of this spell.

spells.name: Crown Of Madness
spells.description: A twisted crown of jagged iron appears on a humanoid's head: Wisdom save or it is charmed, and it must use its action each turn to attack a creature you choose in melee before moving. You spend your action each turn to keep control.

spells.name: Crown Of Stars
spells.description: Seven star-like motes of light orbit your head like a radiant crown, shedding bright light. As a bonus action you can hurl a mote at a creature with a ranged spell attack, dealing 4d12 radiant damage on a hit; the crown dims as its stars are spent.

spells.name: Crusader's Mantle
spells.description: Holy power radiates from you in a 30-foot emanation. While it lasts, you and your allies deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage whenever you hit with a weapon or an unarmed strike.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: Your touch closes wounds: a creature regains 2d8 hit points plus your spellcasting modifier — doubled from the 2014 version in the 2024 revision — and 2d8 more for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Cushidra's Freezing Beam
spells.description: A 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide ray of extreme cold blasts from you. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d8 cold damage or half on a success. The first creature that fails also bursts with icy force: it and every creature within 5 feet of it must make a Constitution save or take 3d8 cold damage and be restrained until the end of its next turn. Higher slots add 1d8 to the beam only.

spells.name: Dancing Lights
spells.description: Up to four drifting lights — torches, lanterns, or a vaguely humanoid shape — float where you direct them, shedding dim light. You can move and recombine them as a bonus action while you concentrate.

spells.name: Danse Macabre
spells.description: Threads of dark energy stitch up to five corpses of Small or Medium creatures into instant undead — skeletons or zombies that fight for you, adding your spellcasting ability modifier to their attack rolls and damage. When the spell ends they collapse back into corpses, and each higher-level slot raises two more.

spells.name: Dark Star
spells.description: A dunamantic sphere of crushing gravity and darkness, 40 feet across, drags creatures toward its heart and grinds them for 8d10 force damage as it appears and as they start their turns within it, while its darkness swallows all light. Constitution saves halve the damage.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.description: Magical darkness fills a 15-foot sphere that even darkvision cannot pierce and nonmagical light cannot brighten. Cast it on a small object and carry the darkness with you, covering the object to shut it off.

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.description: You touch a willing creature and grant it darkvision out to 150 feet for 8 hours — in 2024 the range of the granted sight was notably extended.

spells.name: Dawn
spells.description: The light of dawn breaks in a 60-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of sunlight. A creature makes a Constitution save when the light appears on it, when it first enters on a turn, or when it ends its turn there, taking 4d10 radiant damage on a failure or half on a success, and you can move the dawn 60 feet as a bonus action.

spells.name: Daylight
spells.description: True sunlight blazes from a point or object you touch, filling a 60-foot sphere with bright light and banishing any darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower that it overlaps.

spells.name: Death Armor
spells.description: New in Heroes of Faerun: a shroud of deathly energy clings to a creature you touch, lashing out at those who strike it — creatures that hit the warded creature with melee attacks suffer necrotic retaliation while the armor lasts.

spells.name: Death Shroud
spells.description: You place a death shroud on a creature in range. When you deal damage to it with an attack, you may discard the shroud to deal an additional 2d4 damage. The shroud damage rises to 4d4 at 5th level, 6d4 at 11th, 8d4 at 17th. (Damage type is not stated in the source.)

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.description: You ward a creature against death itself: the first time it would drop to 0 hit points, it drops to 1 instead and the spell ends. Instant-death effects are likewise turned aside, once.

spells.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
spells.description: Your fireball arrives as a small glowing bead that sits, gathering power — 12d6 fire damage, growing by 1d6 at the end of each of your turns — until it detonates in a 20-foot sphere, dealing the accumulated damage on a failed Dexterity save or half on a success.

spells.name: Delfanel's Corrosive Spit
spells.description: You fling highly corrosive acid at a creature. On a failed Constitution save it takes 10d4 acid damage and is coated in acid: attacks against it have advantage while coated, and at the end of each of its turns it may repeat the save, ending the coating on a success.

spells.name: Demiplane
spells.description: A shadowy door opens onto a demiplane of your own making, a room 30 feet in every dimension built of wood or stone as you please. When the spell ends, creatures still inside are trapped unless they can travel the planes — but you can reconnect to any demiplane you know of.

spells.name: Deryan's Helpful Homunculi
spells.description: New in Heroes of Faerun, and castable as a ritual: you conjure a crew of tiny homunculi who set to work on a crafting project, assisting with the mundane labor of making an item for the next 8 hours.

spells.name: Destructive Wave
spells.description: You slam the ground and a wave of divine energy bursts out to 30 feet. Each creature you choose in the area makes a Constitution save, taking 5d6 thunder damage plus 5d6 radiant or necrotic damage (your choice when casting) on a failure and falling Prone, or half as much damage on a success.

spells.name: Detect Evil And Good
spells.description: While you concentrate you sense whether any aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead is within 30 feet, and whether any object or place nearby has been consecrated or desecrated, though cover can block the sense.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: You sense the presence of magic within 30 feet; using an action while it lasts, you can see a faint aura around any creature or object bearing magic and learn its school. Thin barriers block it, and it is often cast as a ritual.

spells.name: Detect Poison And Disease
spells.description: You sense the presence and kind of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet while you concentrate, though solid barriers block the sense.

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.description: You read the surface thoughts of creatures within 30 feet, and can focus on one mind as an action to probe deeper — risking detection if the target makes its Wisdom save. Lead and thick barriers block the reading.

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.description: A word teleports you — and one willing creature your size or smaller — up to 500 feet to a place you picture or describe. Arrive in an occupied space and you both take 4d6 force damage and the jump fails, so choose wisely.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.description: You make yourself — clothes, armor, and gear included — look like someone else of roughly your build for an hour. The disguise is visual only: it fails to touch, and a suspicious creature can pierce it with an Intelligence (Investigation) check.

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.description: A thin green ray streaks to a creature, object, or creation of magical force: a creature that fails its Dexterity save takes 10d6 + 40 force damage, and if that drops it to 0 hit points it is disintegrated into gray dust, revivable only by True Resurrection or Wish. Nonmagical objects and force creations of Large size or smaller are destroyed automatically; upcasting adds 3d6 damage.

spells.name: Dispel Evil And Good
spells.description: Shimmering power wards you against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead: they attack you at disadvantage and cannot Charm, Frighten, or possess you. By touch you can end one such effect on a creature, or attempt a dismissal: the creature makes a Charisma save or is sent back to its home plane.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.description: You unravel magic on one creature, object, or effect: every spell of 3rd level or lower on it ends at once, and for stronger spells you make a spellcasting ability check against each to tear it away. Cast with a higher slot, it automatically ends any spell of that slot's level or lower.

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.description: A discordant melody only one creature can hear wracks it with pain: Wisdom save or 3d6 psychic damage and it must immediately use its reaction to flee from you; on a success it takes half damage and does not flee.

spells.name: Distort Value
spells.description: An Acquisitions Incorporated grifter's trick: you touch an object no larger than a foot in any dimension and make it appear twice or half as valuable to anyone examining it, for up to 8 hours.

spells.name: Divination
spells.description: Your magic offers a gift to a god of knowledge, and in return you receive a truthful reply to one question about an event within the next seven days. The answer accounts for what is known, not for spells or surprises yet to come.

spells.name: Divine Favor
spells.description: Your weapon strikes are blessed for a minute, dealing an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit. In 2024 the spell no longer requires concentration.

spells.name: Divine Smite
spells.description: New as a spell in 2024 (formerly only a class feature): cast it the moment you hit with a melee weapon or unarmed strike to deal an extra 2d8 radiant damage, plus 1d8 more against a fiend or undead. Each higher slot adds 1d8.

spells.name: Divine Word
spells.description: You utter a single word of divine power that washes over creatures you choose. On a failed Charisma save, a creature is deafened, blinded, or stunned depending on how few hit points it has — and the weakest are simply killed, while extraplanar beings are hurled back to their home planes.

spells.name: Dominate Beast
spells.description: A beast that fails a Wisdom save is charmed and bound to your telepathic commands, fighting for you with advantage on its save if you or your companions are already battling it. Higher slots stretch your dominion to minutes or an hour.

spells.name: Dominate Monster
spells.description: You seize the will of any creature, not just a humanoid, bending it to your telepathic commands on a failed Wisdom save. It obeys as fully as it can, repeating the save whenever it takes damage, and you may seize total, precise control with your action.

spells.name: Dominate Person
spells.description: You seize control of a Humanoid that fails a Wisdom save: it is Charmed, linked to you telepathically, and obeys your commands, though you can also seize direct control with your action. It repeats the save each time it takes damage, and higher-level slots stretch the domination to hours.

spells.name: Doomtide
spells.description: An inky sphere of magical darkness boils into being and drifts slowly away from you. Creatures inside it when it appears, or that enter or end their turn within, make a Wisdom save, taking 5d6 psychic damage and subtracting 1d6 from their saving throws on a failure, or half damage on a success — and a strong wind can scatter the whole doom to nothing.

spells.name: Draconic Transformation
spells.description: Draconic magic remakes you: spectral wings grant a 60-foot fly speed, blindsight lets you sense the unseen, and you gain a breath weapon you can exhale in a 60-foot line for 6d8 force damage on a failed Dexterity save (half on a success), once when cast and again as a bonus action.

spells.name: Dragon's Breath
spells.description: You touch a willing creature and gift it a breath weapon of acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison: as an action it can exhale a 15-foot cone for 3d6 damage of that type on a failed Dexterity save (half on a success). Absorbed into the PHB in 2024; each higher slot adds 1d6.

spells.name: Drain
spells.description: A flash of negative energy links you to a creature in range. On a failed Constitution save it takes 3d4 necrotic damage and you gain temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt, lost after 1 minute. Higher slots add 2d4 per slot level above 1st. Material component: a red ribbon.

spells.name: Drawmij's Instant Summons
spells.description: You mark an object of 10 pounds or less with an invisible sigil and inscribe its name on a sapphire. Whenever you later crush the sapphire as a Magic action and speak the name, the object flies instantly to your hand across any distance — unless another creature is holding it, in which case you learn who holds it and where they are.

spells.name: Dream
spells.description: You send a messenger into the dreams of a sleeping creature on your plane, shaping the dream and conversing through it. You can instead make the messenger monstrous: when the target wakes it makes a Wisdom save or takes 3d6 psychic damage and gains no benefit from that rest.

spells.name: Dream Of The Blue Veil
spells.description: You and up to eight companions fall into a visionary sleep of another world of the Material Plane — Toril, Oerth, Eberron, and beyond — guided by an item or native of that world. If the dream completes, you draw back a blue curtain and wake already standing in that world; damage breaks the dream and strands no one.

spells.name: Druid Grove
spells.description: Nature spirits rise to guard an area up to a 90-foot cube: you can fill squares with solid fog or grasping undergrowth, raise guardian trees that lash at intruders, and ward the whole grove, while creatures you name as friends (or who speak your password) are immune to its effects. Cast in the same place every day for a year, the grove lasts until dispelled.

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you predict the weather for the next day, make a flower bloom or a seed pod open, create a harmless nature effect, or light or snuff a small flame.

spells.name: Dust Devil
spells.description: A whirling dust devil fills a 5-foot cube: any creature ending its turn within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d8 bludgeoning damage and is flung 10 feet in a random direction. You can move it 30 feet as a bonus action; it sucks loose debris into obscuring clouds.

spells.name: Earth Tremor
spells.description: The ground shudders around you: each other creature within 10 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone, and loose earth or stone in the area becomes difficult terrain for a minute.

spells.name: Earthbind
spells.description: Strips of energy bind one flying creature: Strength save or its flying speed drops to 0 and it descends safely at 60 feet per round for the duration — grounded, not crashed.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.description: The earth shakes, rips, and convulses across a 100-foot circle: creatures are knocked prone on a failed Dexterity save, concentration falters, fissures yawn open, and structures crumble under 50 points of bludgeoning damage each round until the ground settles.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: A crackling beam of eldritch force streaks at a creature; on a hit with your ranged spell attack it takes 1d10 force damage. You loose additional beams at higher levels (two at 5th, three at 11th, four at 17th), each rolled separately.

spells.name: Elemental Bane
spells.description: You curse a creature that fails a Constitution save with vulnerability to an element you name — acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder: it loses any resistance to that damage, and the first time it is hit by that element each turn it takes an extra 2d6 damage.

spells.name: Elemental Weapon
spells.description: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes magical, gaining a +1 bonus to attack rolls and dealing an extra 1d4 damage of an element you choose — acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Higher slots sharpen both the bonus and the elemental bite.

spells.name: Elementalism
spells.description: A new 2024 cantrip of small elemental tricks: fan a fire, stir a breeze, mist the air, dampen earth, or light a flame with a gesture — the elements answer in minor, mostly harmless ways.

spells.name: Elminster's Elusion
spells.description: New in Heroes of Faerun, named for the Sage of Shadowdale himself: a personal warding that shields you against spells and magical effects — the sort of protection a wizard needs when other wizards are the opposition.

spells.name: Encode Thoughts
spells.description: From Ravnica's Dimir: you draw one of your thoughts out as a silvery strand of mental energy that persists for 8 hours, readable by anyone who casts this spell or can read thoughts, and useless to everyone else.

spells.name: Enemies Abound
spells.description: You seize a creature's mind with an Intelligence save or its world curdles into paranoia: every other creature becomes its enemy, and on each turn it lashes out at a randomly chosen target within reach. Creatures immune to fear shrug the spell off.

spells.name: Enervation
spells.description: A tendril of inky darkness reaches out to drain a creature: on a failed Dexterity save it takes 4d8 necrotic damage and stays tethered, so you can use your action on later turns to deal 4d8 necrotic damage automatically; on a success it takes 2d8 damage and the spell ends. Whenever the spell deals damage, you regain hit points equal to half of it, and upcasting adds 1d8.

spells.name: Enhance Ability
spells.description: Simplified in 2024: you touch a creature and choose an ability score; for up to an hour it has advantage on ability checks using that score. Each higher slot touches one more creature.

spells.name: Enlarge/reduce
spells.description: A creature or object grows by one size category or shrinks by one (an unwilling creature resists with a Constitution save). Enlarged creatures gain advantage on Strength checks and saves and +1d4 damage on weapon attacks; reduced creatures suffer the reverse.

spells.name: Ensnaring Strike
spells.description: Cast as you land a weapon attack: grasping vines erupt around the target, which makes a Strength save or is restrained, taking 1d6 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns until it or an ally tears it free with a Strength check. Damage rises 1d6 per higher slot.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.description: Grasping weeds and vines fill a 20-foot square, making it difficult terrain. Creatures in the area make Strength saves or are restrained until they break free with a Strength check as an action.

spells.name: Enthrall
spells.description: Your words weave a captivating patter: creatures of your choice that can hear you make Wisdom saves or are so enthralled that they have disadvantage on Perception checks to notice anything but you.

spells.name: Erupting Earth
spells.description: The ground explodes in a 20-foot cube of churning earth and stone. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d12 bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success, and the area is left as difficult terrain.

spells.name: Etherealness
spells.description: You step sideways into the Border Ethereal, where you can see and move through the world as a ghost, passing through solid matter while the material world can barely touch you. Cast with a higher slot, you can bring companions with you.

spells.name: Evard's Black Tentacles
spells.description: Squirming black tentacles fill a 20-foot square of difficult terrain. A creature that starts its turn there or enters the area makes a Dexterity save or takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained, writhing, until it breaks free with a Strength or Dexterity check.

spells.name: Expeditious Retreat
spells.description: Magic lends speed to your heels: when you cast it and as a bonus action on later turns while you concentrate, you can take the Dash action.

spells.name: Eyebite
spells.description: Your eyes become inky voids of dread. When you cast the spell and as a Magic action on later turns, choose a creature within 60 feet: on a failed Wisdom save it suffers one effect of your choice — Comatose (the Unconscious condition), Panicked (the Frightened condition, forced to flee you), or Sickened (the Poisoned condition).

spells.name: Fabricate
spells.description: Raw materials reshape themselves at your command — timber into a bridge, flax into rope or cloth, stone and metal into finished goods. Crafting anything intricate demands the artisan's proficiency to match.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.description: Objects and creatures in a 20-foot cube are outlined in colored light. Creatures that fail a Dexterity save shed dim light for the duration, and attacks against outlined creatures have advantage if the attacker can see them.

spells.name: False Life
spells.description: A necromantic facsimile of life bolsters you: in 2024 you gain 2d4 + 4 temporary hit points (up from 1d4 + 4), plus 5 more for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Far Step
spells.description: You slip through the planes in a blink, teleporting up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see — and you can repeat the hop as a bonus action on each of your turns until the spell ends.

spells.name: Fast Friends
spells.description: You whisper at a humanoid that fails a Wisdom save and it becomes your devoted new friend — charmed, eager to please, and willing to do you a service within reason for the hour. When the spell ends, it knows exactly what you did.

spells.name: Fear
spells.description: You project each victim's worst fear in a 30-foot cone: creatures that fail a Wisdom save drop what they hold and flee, spending their turns Dashing away from you until they save at the end of a turn, which they can only attempt once out of your sight.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.description: Cast in reaction when you or a creature within 60 feet falls: up to five falling creatures descend at a gentle 60 feet per round and land on their feet unharmed.

spells.name: Feign Death
spells.description: A willing creature you touch falls into a cataleptic state indistinguishable from death — blinded, incapacitated, and resistant to nearly all damage, yet unharmed by the pretense. The spell ends early if you dismiss it or the target is disturbed by outside force.

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.description: You gain the service of a familiar — a celestial, fey, or fiend spirit in the form of a small animal such as a bat, cat, owl, or toad. It acts independently but obeys you, cannot attack, and you can see through its eyes and deliver touch spells through it.

spells.name: Find Greater Steed
spells.description: A celestial, fey, or fiendish spirit answers your call in the form of a noble mount — a griffon, pegasus, dire wolf, or another great beast — bound to you in loyal telepathic service until it falls or you dismiss it.

spells.name: Find Steed
spells.description: In 2024 this is a quick action rather than a long ritual: an otherworldly steed — a warhorse, elk, or similar mount with a telepathic bond to you — appears beside you, loyal unto death and resummonable if it falls.

spells.name: Find The Path
spells.description: You name a location you are familiar with on your plane, and for the duration you always know how far it is, in which direction it lies, and which path is most direct whenever the way forks.

spells.name: Find Traps
spells.description: You sense the presence of any trap within range and line of sight — an alarm, a glyph, a poisoned needle — learning that danger is there, though not precisely where or how it works.

spells.name: Find Vessel
spells.description: You summon a spirit that assumes the form of a waterborne vessel of your choice — galley, keelboat, longship, rowboat, sailing ship, or war ship — in an unoccupied space in range, with that form's Dungeon Master's Guide statistics, immunity to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and doubled speed, cargo limit, and hit points. You have advantage on checks to steer it, it obeys your verbal commands while you are aboard (ignoring minimum crew), and you may recast the spell to restore it to full hit points. It vanishes at 0 hit points or when you dismiss it as an action, leaving its occupants and cargo behind; only one vessel at a time.

spells.name: Finger Of Death
spells.description: A lance of negative energy wracks one creature, dealing 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage on a failed Constitution save or half on a success. A humanoid slain by it rises at the start of your next turn as a zombie forever under your command.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: You hurl a mote of fire with a ranged spell attack, dealing 1d10 fire damage on a hit and igniting flammable objects that are not worn or carried. The damage increases at higher levels.

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.description: Wispy flames wreath your body, shedding light: choose a warm shield that resists cold or a chill shield that resists fire. Either way, a creature that hits you with a melee attack within 5 feet is seared for 2d8 damage of the shield's element.

spells.name: Fire Storm
spells.description: A storm of roaring flame appears where you will it, built from up to ten contiguous 10-foot cubes you arrange like blocks. Every creature in the area makes a Dexterity save, taking 7d10 fire damage on a failure or half on a success, and unattended flammables ignite.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: A bead of fire streaks to a point you choose and erupts in a 20-foot sphere of flame. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success, and unattended flammables ignite.

spells.name: Fizban's Platinum Shield
spells.description: A spectral platinum shield, shaped like a dragon wing, guards a creature you can see: it gains a +2 bonus to AC and resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison damage. You can move the shield to another creature as a bonus action, and the warded creature can use a reaction when it takes damage of one of those types to become immune to that instance.

spells.name: Flame Arrows
spells.description: You touch a quiver holding twelve arrows or bolts, and each piece drawn from it trails fire, dealing an extra 1d6 fire damage on a hit. A higher slot enchants two more pieces of ammunition per level.

spells.name: Flame Blade
spells.description: A blade of fire, shaped like a scimitar, ignites in your hand. As an action you can strike with it as a melee spell attack for 3d6 fire damage; the damage grows when cast with higher slots.

spells.name: Flame Strike
spells.description: A column of divine flame roars down in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d6 fire damage plus 5d6 radiant damage on a failure, or half as much on a success; upcasting adds 1d6 to each damage type.

spells.name: Flaming Sphere
spells.description: A 5-foot ball of fire rolls where you direct it: as a bonus action you can ram it 30 feet, and creatures within 5 feet of it when it stops — or that end their turn beside it — make Dexterity saves or take 2d6 fire damage (half on a success). Each higher slot adds 1d6.

spells.name: Flesh To Stone
spells.description: You try to turn one creature you can see to stone: on a failed Constitution save it gains the Restrained condition as its flesh hardens (on a success its speed is simply 0 until the start of your next turn). It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns — three successes end the spell, three failures leave it Petrified, and if you hold concentration for the full duration the stone lasts until freed by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

spells.name: Fly
spells.description: A willing creature you touch gains a flying speed of 60 feet until the spell ends — though if the magic fades mid-flight, it falls. Higher slots lift additional creatures.

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of fog billows out, heavily obscuring its area until a strong wind disperses it. Its radius grows by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Forbiddance
spells.description: You ward up to 40,000 square feet against magical travel: teleportation and planar portals fail into the area, and creature types you choose (from Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead) take 5d10 radiant or necrotic damage (your choice) the first time they enter on a turn or when they end their turn there, unless they speak the password you set. Cast daily for 30 days, it lasts until dispelled.

spells.name: Forcecage
spells.description: An immobile prison of invisible force springs up around your targets — either a barred cage 20 feet across or a solid box 10 feet across. Nothing physical or teleporting easily escapes it, and creatures trapped inside are cut off from the fight entirely.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.description: Your touch grants a creature a limited vision of its own immediate future: for 8 hours it cannot be surprised and rolls attacks, ability checks, and saving throws with advantage, while every roll made against it has disadvantage.

spells.name: Fortune's Favor
spells.description: A dunamancy blessing: you touch a creature and fragment its possible futures. Within the hour, once, when it fails an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, it can reroll — a mote of luck consumed.

spells.name: Fount Of Moonlight
spells.description: Moonlight drenches you in silvery radiance: you resist radiant damage, your melee attacks deal an extra 2d6 radiant damage, and as a reaction when a creature within 60 feet damages you, you can force it to make a Constitution save or be blinded by the glare until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Freedom Of Movement
spells.description: A willing creature you touch slips every bond for an hour: terrain, spells, and grapples cannot slow or restrain it, and it can even spend 5 feet of movement to escape nonmagical restraints outright. Higher slots free additional creatures.

spells.name: Freedom Of The Waves
spells.description: A deluge of seawater bursts forth as a tidal wave, whirlpool, or waterspout in a 15-foot-wide cylinder. Each creature in it makes a Strength save or takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage and falls prone — sparing a few creatures of your choice — and if you are within the deluge, you may vanish into it and reappear at another point inside.

spells.name: Friends
spells.description: Reworked in 2024: you magically influence one creature you can see, which makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for the duration. When the spell ends, the target knows it was charmed.

spells.name: Frost Fingers
spells.description: From Icewind Dale: freezing cold blasts from your fingertips. Each creature in the 15-foot cone makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 cold damage on a failure or half on a success; each higher slot adds 1d8.

spells.name: Frostbite
spells.description: Rime creeps over one creature, which makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 cold damage and has disadvantage on the next weapon attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. The damage scales at higher levels.

spells.name: Fungal Bloom
spells.description: As part of casting you make a ranged weapon attack against a creature in range, or the spell fails. On a hit it suffers the attack's normal effects and a fungal bloom appears in three unoccupied spaces of your choice adjacent to it until the end of your next turn; a creature moving through a bloom destroys it and takes 1d6 poison damage. At 5th level the attack deals an extra 1d6 poison and blooms deal an extra 1d6, both rising by 1d6 at 11th (2d6/3d6) and 17th (3d6/4d6). Material component: a ranged weapon.

spells.name: Galder's Speedy Courier
spells.description: An air elemental appears with a small chest: whatever you seal inside is whisked anywhere on your plane to a creature you name, which has ten minutes to take from the chest and reply in kind before the courier returns.

spells.name: Galder's Tower
spells.description: You conjure a two-story stone tower, 10 feet square, furnished as you direct — bedroom, study, and more — that stands for 24 hours. Higher slots add extra floors, each another room of your choosing.

spells.name: Gaseous Form
spells.description: A willing creature and everything it carries dissolve into misty vapor: it flies slowly, slips through the tiniest cracks, and shrugs off most damage, but cannot speak, fight, or manipulate objects until it resolidifies.

spells.name: Gate
spells.description: A shining portal 20 feet across opens between planes, its far side placed with pinpoint precision. Speak the true name of a creature on the far side and the gate drags it through to you — though deities and planar rulers may refuse or forbid the passage in their own domains.

spells.name: Gate Seal
spells.description: You fortify the fabric of the planes in a 30-foot cube: portals within it slam shut and cannot open, and spells of planar travel fail to enter or leave the sealed space. Cast with a 6th-level slot or higher, the seal holds until dispelled.

spells.name: Geas
spells.description: You lay a magical command on a creature that can understand you: carry out a service, or refrain from an action, as you direct. On a failed Wisdom save it is Charmed for the duration, and each day it acts against your instructions it takes 5d10 psychic damage (no more than once per day); higher-level slots extend the geas to a year or make it last until ended.

spells.name: Gentle Repose
spells.description: You protect a corpse for 10 days: it does not decay, cannot become undead, and the time does not count against spells that raise the dead. Often cast as a ritual over the fallen.

spells.name: Ghastly Stench
spells.description: You emanate the putrid stench of a ghast. For the duration, each creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. Higher slots increase the radius by 5 feet per slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Giant Insect
spells.description: You summon a giant centipede, spider, or wasp using the Giant Insect stat block, which scales with the slot you spend. It shares your initiative, obeys your verbal commands, and fights beside you until it drops or the spell ends.

spells.name: Gift Of Alacrity
spells.description: A dunamancy gift from Wildemount: a willing creature gains a 1d8 bonus to its initiative rolls for 8 hours, its reflexes sharpened by stolen moments of time.

spells.name: Gift Of Gab
spells.description: From Acquisitions Incorporated, cast in reaction the moment you say something regrettable: everyone's memory of the last 6 seconds of conversation is magically replaced, letting you take back the sentence you just blew.

spells.name: Give Life
spells.description: You place your hand on another creature and transfer your own life force to it: you spend and roll one of your hit dice, add your spellcasting modifier, and the creature regains hit points equal to the total. (Catalog ruling 2026-11-06, item 14: the Scholar printing's formula is adopted — its class line includes Magus (Sylvan Circle), so it claims to govern the Magus caster too, and the +mod is not the Theologian differentiator; Martyr's Magic is. The Magus printing's no-modifier formula is superseded.) Scholar access for the Scholar class itself comes via the Martyr's Magic erudite application, not via this classes array.

spells.name: Glibness
spells.description: Your words gain an enchanted silver: for an hour, any Charisma check you roll below 15 counts as 15, and magic that would detect your lies cannot tell truth from falsehood — you simply decide what it reports.

spells.name: Globe Of Invulnerability
spells.description: A shimmering, immobile barrier surrounds you in a 10-foot emanation. Spells of 5th level or lower cast from outside simply cannot affect anything within it, and their areas stop at the barrier; each higher-level slot raises the blocked spell level by one.

spells.name: Glyph Of Warding
spells.description: You inscribe a charged glyph on a surface or object and set its trigger. When sprung, explosive runes blast everything within 20 feet for 5d8 damage of an element you chose (Dexterity save for half), or a spell glyph stored inside discharges a spell you cast into it.

spells.name: Goodberry
spells.description: Ten magical berries appear in your hand, fresh for 24 hours. Eating one restores 1 hit point and nourishes the creature for a full day.

spells.name: Grasping Vine
spells.description: A vine erupts from the ground and lashes out with your spell attack: on a hit it deals 4d8 bludgeoning damage, drags the target up to 30 feet toward it, and grapples it if it is Huge or smaller. As a bonus action on later turns you can strike again.

spells.name: Gravity Fissure
spells.description: A ravine of gravitational energy tears open in a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line from you. Each creature in the line makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 force damage on a failure or half on a success, and each creature within 10 feet of the line that fails the same save takes 8d8 force damage and is dragged into the fissure. A dunamancy spell of the Graviturgy tradition; upcasting adds 1d8.

spells.name: Gravity Sinkhole
spells.description: Dunamis collapses into a crushing sinkhole in a 20-foot sphere: each creature in it makes a Constitution save, taking 5d10 force damage and being dragged toward the center on a failure, or half damage and its footing on a success.

spells.name: Grease
spells.description: Slick grease coats a 10-foot square (and yes, the 2024 text confirms it was never flammable). Creatures in the area, and any that enter or end their turn there, make Dexterity saves or fall prone.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.description: You or a creature you touch vanishes from sight — gear and all — for the duration, and unlike lesser invisibility, attacking or casting does not reveal the hidden one.

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.description: Soothing energy washes through a creature you touch, consuming diamond dust to undo one great affliction: end the Charmed or Petrified condition, lift a curse, restore a reduced ability score or hit point maximum, or reduce its exhaustion by one level.

spells.name: Green-flame Blade
spells.description: As part of casting you make a melee weapon attack; green flame leaps from the target to a second creature within 5 feet, dealing fire damage equal to your spellcasting modifier to it. At 5th level both the attack and the leap gain extra fire damage.

spells.name: Guardian Of Faith
spells.description: A Large spectral guardian bearing your god's emblem hovers in place for up to eight hours. Any enemy that moves within 10 feet of it or starts its turn there makes a Dexterity save, taking 20 radiant damage on a failure or half on a success — and after dealing 60 damage in all, the guardian's duty is done.

spells.name: Guardian Of Nature
spells.description: A nature spirit transforms you into a guardian: take the Primal Beast form — faster, feral, your Strength attacks keen and your melee hits dealing extra force — or the Great Tree form — rooted, bark-skinned, gaining temporary hit points and advantage on Constitution saves while the ground around you hinders your enemies.

spells.name: Guards And Wards
spells.description: You ward up to 2,500 square feet of floor space: corridors fill with confusing fog, doors lock as if by Arcane Lock (some hidden behind illusions), and stairs web over. You also plant one extra effect — dancing lights, magic mouths, a Stinking Cloud, a Gust of Wind, or a Suggestion trap — and people you name, or who speak your password, pass unharmed. Cast every day for a year, the ward lasts until dispelled.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.description: You touch a willing creature and, in the 2024 version, choose a skill when you cast. For the duration, the creature adds 1d4 to ability checks made with that chosen skill.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.description: A flash of divine light: ranged spell attack for 4d6 radiant damage, and the target shimmers with mystical light so the next attack roll against it before the end of your next turn has advantage. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

spells.name: Gust
spells.description: A sudden blast of wind shoves one creature — Strength save or be pushed 5 feet away — or moves loose objects, or makes a harmless sensory gust that slams doors and scatters leaves.

spells.name: Gust Of Wind
spells.description: A 60-foot line of strong wind blasts from you: creatures in it make Strength saves or are pushed 15 feet away, the wind disperses gas and fog, and as a bonus action you can redirect the line.

spells.name: Hail Of Thorns
spells.description: In 2024 this is a bonus action that triggers instantly on your next ranged hit, with no concentration: the projectile bursts into thorns, and the target and each creature within 5 feet of it make Dexterity saves, taking 1d10 piercing damage on a failure (half on a success). Each higher slot adds 1d10.

spells.name: Hallow
spells.description: You consecrate ground in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Creature types you choose cannot willingly enter, and those inside are shielded from being Charmed, Frightened, or possessed by them, and corpses in the area cannot become Undead. You also bind one extra effect to the ground — such as silence, darkness, fear, or everlasting rest — resisted by a Charisma save.

spells.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
spells.description: Natural terrain in a 150-foot cube is dressed in illusion — meadow over swamp, gentle slope over precipice — with look, sound, and smell to match, though touch betrays the truth and structures and creatures keep their forms.

spells.name: Harm
spells.description: Virulent disease magic ravages a creature you can see: on a failed Constitution save it takes 14d6 necrotic damage and its hit point maximum is reduced by the same amount (never below 1); on a success it takes half damage and its maximum is untouched.

spells.name: Haste
spells.description: A willing creature surges with speed: its speed doubles, it gains +2 AC and advantage on Dexterity saves, and it gets an extra action each turn for attacks, dashing, or dodging. When the spell ends, the rush drains away and it loses a turn to lethargy.

spells.name: Heal
spells.description: Positive energy washes through a creature you can see, restoring 70 hit points and ending the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions on it. Each higher-level slot restores 10 more hit points.

spells.name: Healing Spirit
