spells.description: A translucent nature spirit appears in a 5-foot cube. When you or an ally moves into its space or starts a turn there, the spirit restores 1d6 hit points — it can heal a number of times equal to your spellcasting modifier before fading.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: A word of comfort knits wounds at range: one creature regains 2d4 hit points plus your spellcasting modifier — buffed in 2024 — leaving your action free, and gains 2d4 more per higher slot.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.description: A piece of metal — armor, a weapon — glows red-hot. Any creature touching it takes 2d8 fire damage; as a bonus action each turn you can deal the damage again, and a holder must make a Constitution save or drop the object (and suffers disadvantage while it clings on). Each higher slot adds 1d8.

spells.name: Hellish Rebuke
spells.description: Cast in reaction to being damaged: you point at the creature that hurt you and it is momentarily engulfed in hellish flame, making a Dexterity save or taking 2d10 fire damage (half on a success). Each higher slot adds 1d10.

spells.name: Heroes' Feast
spells.description: You conjure a magnificent feast that takes an hour to eat; up to twelve partakers then gain blessings for 24 hours: resistance to poison damage, immunity to the Frightened and Poisoned conditions, and a hit point maximum increased by 2d10, gaining the same number of hit points.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.description: A willing creature is flooded with courage: it is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier at the start of each of its turns while you concentrate.

spells.name: Hex
spells.description: You curse a creature: your attacks deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage to it, and it has disadvantage on ability checks with one ability you choose. If it dies, you can move the curse to a new creature; the duration stretches to 8 or 24 hours in higher slots.

spells.name: Hold Monster
spells.description: A creature of your choice that you can see freezes in place on a failed Wisdom save, gaining the Paralyzed condition; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Each higher-level slot lets you bind one additional creature.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.description: A humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is paralyzed, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Attacks against a paralyzed creature have advantage, and hits from within 5 feet are automatic criticals. Each higher slot targets one more humanoid.

spells.name: Holy Aura
spells.description: Divine light washes over you and allies within 30 feet, granting advantage on saving throws and making attackers roll at disadvantage. When a fiend or undead strikes one of the warded with a melee attack, the light flares — it must make a Constitution save or be blinded until the spell ends.

spells.name: Holy Weapon
spells.description: A weapon you touch glows with holy light and deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage on every hit. As a bonus action you can end the spell in a burst of radiance: each creature of your choice within 30 feet makes a Constitution save, taking 4d8 radiant damage and the Blinded condition for 1 minute on a failure, or half damage on a success.

spells.name: Homunculus Servant
spells.description: Over an hour of ritual work with a gem worth at least 100 gold, you shape a tiny construct servant. It shares your initiative and acts right after you, follows your orders without costing you an action, and otherwise dodges and keeps itself out of harm's way. It can carry your touch-range spells to a target within 120 feet, and a new casting replaces any servant you already have.

spells.name: Hunger Of Hadar
spells.description: You tear open a 20-foot sphere of cold, lightless void filled with milky, rubbery tentacles. Creatures starting their turn inside take 2d6 cold damage, the area is difficult terrain, and at the end of a turn the tentacles lash out — a failed Dexterity save means 2d6 acid damage.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.description: You mark a creature as your quarry: your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 damage to it, and you have advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find it. If it falls, you can move the mark to a new creature with a bonus action.

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern
spells.description: A twisting pattern of colors weaves through a 30-foot cube. Each creature in it that sees the pattern makes a Wisdom save or is charmed and incapacitated, rooted in a stupor until it is shaken awake or takes damage.

spells.name: Ice Knife
spells.description: You throw a shard of ice with a ranged spell attack for 1d10 piercing damage; hit or miss, the shard explodes, and the target and each creature within 5 feet make Dexterity saves or take 2d6 cold damage. Absorbed into the PHB in 2024; the cold damage rises 1d6 per higher slot.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.description: Hailstones pound down in a 20-foot-wide, 40-foot-tall cylinder: each creature in it makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d8 bludgeoning and 4d6 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. The ground is left difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Identify
spells.description: Handling an item or creature throughout the casting, you learn its magical properties, how to use them, whether it requires attunement, and how many charges it holds; on a creature you learn which spells are affecting it.

spells.name: Illusory Dragon
spells.description: Shadowstuff coalesces into a dragon of your design, terrifying to behold: creatures who see it must save against Wisdom or be frightened, and as a bonus action you breathe its chosen elemental breath across the battlefield. It cannot be harmed, and even those who pierce the illusion still take half its breath damage.

spells.name: Illusory Script
spells.description: You write a message that appears as entirely different writing to everyone except creatures you designate. Others see whatever innocent text you choose; truesight pierces the deception.

spells.name: Immolation
spells.description: Flames wreathe one creature you can see: on a failed Dexterity save it takes 7d6 fire damage and catches fire, taking 3d6 fire damage at the end of each of its turns until it succeeds on the repeated save; on a success it takes half damage and does not burn. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this spell burns to ash.

spells.name: Immovable Object
spells.description: Dunamancy pins an object of up to 10 pounds in place in mid-air: it takes a Strength check against your spell DC (with a heavy bonus per 10 extra pounds) to move it so much as 10 feet. Higher slots pin far heavier objects, and at 6th level the effect can be made permanent.

spells.name: Imprisonment
spells.description: You bind a creature in a magical prison of your design — buried in an extradimensional sphere, chained in place, trapped in a gem, or locked in timeless slumber within a demiplane. A Wisdom save resists; otherwise only the special release condition you set, or the mightiest dispelling, can free it.

spells.name: Incendiary Cloud
spells.description: A roiling cloud of smoke and white-hot embers, 20 feet across, billows into being and drifts away from you as you direct. Creatures entering it or ending their turn inside take 10d8 fire damage on a failed Dexterity save, or half on a success, and its smoke heavily obscures the area.

spells.name: Incite Greed
spells.description: You present a gem and let covetousness do the rest: creatures that can see it make a Wisdom save or are charmed and can do nothing but move to reach out and touch the prize, oblivious to everything else until they grasp it.

spells.name: Infernal Calling
spells.description: You summon a devil of challenge rating 6 or lower (more with a higher-level slot) and bargain for its service. The devil is not automatically obedient: commands against its nature demand an opposed contest of your Charisma against its insight, and if your concentration breaks it stays, free and likely hostile.

spells.name: Infestation
spells.description: A cloud of biting mites and fleas swarms one creature, which makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 poison damage and is driven 5 feet in a random direction. The damage scales at higher levels.

spells.name: Inflict Wounds
spells.description: Reworked in 2024: your touch channels necrotic energy into a creature, which now makes a Constitution save (instead of you making an attack roll), taking 3d10 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Each higher slot adds 1d10.

spells.name: Insect Plague
spells.description: A swarming cloud of biting locusts fills a 20-foot-radius sphere, lightly obscuring it and making it difficult terrain. A creature makes a Constitution save when the swarm appears on it, when it first enters on a turn, or when it ends its turn there, taking 4d10 piercing damage on a failure or half on a success.

spells.name: Intellect Fortress
spells.description: You fortify a willing creature's mind: it gains resistance to psychic damage and advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

spells.name: Investiture Of Flame
spells.description: Flames wrap your body: you are immune to fire damage, resistant to cold, and shed bright light. As an action you can hurl a 15-foot line of fire that deals 4d8 fire damage on a failed Dexterity save, or half on a success.

spells.name: Investiture Of Ice
spells.description: Frost sheathes your body: you are immune to cold damage, resistant to fire, and the ground within 10 feet of you is difficult terrain for others. As an action you can exhale a 15-foot cone of freezing wind: creatures make a Constitution save, taking 4d6 cold damage and having their speed reduced to 0 until the end of your next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success.

spells.name: Investiture Of Stone
spells.description: Stone merges with your skin: you gain resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and tremorsense out to 60 feet. As an action you can set off a small earthquake in a 15-foot radius around you — other creatures on the ground make a Dexterity save or gain the Prone condition.

spells.name: Investiture Of Wind
spells.description: Wind swirls protectively around you: ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage and you gain a flying speed of 60 feet. As an action you can blast a 15-foot cube of air — creatures there make a Constitution save or take 2d10 bludgeoning damage and are pushed 10 feet away.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.description: A creature you touch vanishes from sight until it attacks, casts a spell, or your concentration ends. Each higher slot hides one additional creature.

spells.name: Invulnerability
spells.description: For as long as you hold the spell, you are simply immune to all damage. Blades, fire, and falling rubble alike break harmlessly against you until your concentration fails.

spells.name: Jallarzi's Storm Of Radiance
spells.description: A storm of light and sound rages in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder: creatures inside are Blinded and Deafened and cannot cast spells with verbal components. A creature that enters the storm or ends its turn there makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 radiant damage plus 2d10 thunder damage on a failure, or half on a success; upcasting adds 1d10 to each.

spells.name: Jim's Glowing Coin
spells.description: From Acquisitions Incorporated: you toss a coin that glows with irresistible avarice. Creatures within 30 feet of where it lands that fail Wisdom saves are distracted and fascinated by it, and suffer disadvantage on initiative, until they take damage or shake it off.

spells.name: Jim's Magic Missile
spells.description: Jim Darkmagic's flashier, riskier take on Magic Missile: three darts that each need a ranged spell attack roll but deal 1d4 + 1 force damage on a hit — and a natural 1 misfires into the caster instead. Each higher slot adds a dart.

spells.name: Jump
spells.description: In 2024 this is a bonus action: you touch a creature and, once on each of its turns for a minute, it can jump up to 30 feet by spending only 10 feet of movement.

spells.name: Kinetic Jaunt
spells.description: From Strixhaven: kinetic magic quickens you — your speed rises by 10 feet and your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks while you concentrate, up to a minute.

spells.name: Knock
spells.description: Choose a lock, manacle, or barred portal: it opens — locks unlock, stuck doors unstick, even Arcane Lock is suppressed for 10 minutes. The spell Bangs loudly, however, audible 300 feet away.

spells.name: Laeral's Silver Lance
spells.description: Silver energy erupts from you in a 120-foot line. Each creature of your choice in the line makes a Strength save, taking 3d10 force damage and being knocked prone on a failure, or half as much damage and its footing on a success.

spells.name: Lay Waste
spells.description: You create six tiny orbs of negative energy that orbit you for the duration. When you cast the spell, and as a bonus action on each of your turns thereafter, you may expend one or two orbs, sending them to points within 120 feet; on reaching a destination or a solid surface each orb explodes, and each creature within 5 feet of the explosion point makes a Constitution save, taking 2d6 necrotic damage or half on a success. Higher slots create two additional orbs per slot level above 3rd.

spells.name: Legend Lore
spells.description: You name a person, place, or object of legendary importance and receive a summary of the significant lore about it, gathered from sources you may never have seen. The more you already know of the subject, the more detailed and precise the lore.

spells.name: Leomund's Secret Chest
spells.description: An ornate chest vanishes into the Ethereal Plane, and with its miniature replica you can recall it — contents and all — whenever you wish, or banish it again as an action. Lose the replica, and your treasures are stranded beyond reach.

spells.name: Leomund's Tiny Hut
spells.description: A 10-foot dome of force springs up around you and up to nine companions, opaque from outside and comfortable within. Nothing — creatures, objects, or spells — can pass its barrier, making it a near-perfect shelter for a night's rest.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.description: Now a bonus action in 2024: your touch ends one condition afflicting a creature — blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.description: One creature or object of up to 500 pounds rises vertically (an unwilling creature resists with a Constitution save) and hovers, moving only by pushing or pulling against fixed surfaces. You can adjust its height by 20 feet as an action.

spells.name: Life Transference
spells.description: You sacrifice your own vitality: you take 4d8 necrotic damage that cannot be reduced or prevented, and one creature you can see is healed for twice the damage you suffered.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: An object you touch glows like a torch, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light beyond it. A hostile creature wearing or holding the object can resist with a Dexterity save.

spells.name: Lightning Arrow
spells.description: Cast in the instant your ranged attack lands or misses, your weapon or ammunition becomes a bolt of lightning: the target takes 4d8 lightning damage instead of the attack's normal effects (half on a miss), and every creature within 10 feet of it makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d8 lightning damage, half on a success.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.description: A stroke of lightning blasts out in a 100-foot line. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success, and flammable objects in the path ignite.

spells.name: Lightning Lure
spells.description: A lash of lightning seizes one creature within 15 feet: Strength save or be pulled up to 10 feet toward you, taking 1d8 lightning damage if it ends within 5 feet of you. The damage scales at higher levels.

spells.name: Locate Animals Or Plants
spells.description: You name a kind of beast or plant and sense the direction and distance to the nearest one within 5 miles, if any is there. A ritual answer to a wilderness search.

spells.name: Locate Creature
spells.description: Name a creature you know, or the nearest of a kind you have seen up close, and the spell points you toward it while it is within 1,000 feet — including which way it is moving. Running water at least 10 feet wide blocks the trail cold.

spells.name: Locate Object
spells.description: You sense the direction to an object you name — a specific one you have seen up close, or a kind of object — so long as it is within 1,000 feet. A thin sheet of lead blocks the sense entirely.

spells.name: Longstrider
spells.description: You touch a creature and quicken it: its speed increases by 10 feet for an hour. Each higher slot quickens one additional creature.

spells.name: Maddening Darkness
spells.description: Magical darkness filled with shrieking, gibbering horrors spreads in a 60-foot sphere that no light — not even magical — can pierce. Creatures starting their turn inside take 8d8 psychic damage on a failed Wisdom save, or half on a success.

spells.name: Maelstrom
spells.description: A 20-foot-radius vortex of churning water seizes the ground, which becomes difficult terrain as everything in it is dragged 10 feet toward the center. A creature that starts its turn in the maelstrom makes a Strength save, taking 6d6 bludgeoning damage on a failure and nothing on a success.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.description: A protective force surrounds a willing creature that is not wearing armor: its base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier for 8 hours, ending early if it dons armor.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: A spectral floating hand appears and obeys your gestures for a minute: it can manipulate objects, open unlocked containers, retrieve items, and pour potions, but it cannot attack or carry more than 10 pounds.

spells.name: Magic Circle
spells.description: Glowing runes circle a 10-foot cylinder, barring celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead (your choice): they cannot willingly enter, attack those inside at disadvantage, and cannot charm or possess them. Reversed, the circle becomes a prison for one such creature.

spells.name: Magic Jar
spells.description: Your body falls catatonic as your soul slips into a gem or reliquary worth 500 gp. From there you can project your soul up to 100 feet to possess a Humanoid: on a failed Charisma save its soul is trapped in the container while you control its body, keeping your mind and class features but taking its physical statistics.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: Three glowing darts of force strike creatures of your choice, unerringly, each dealing 1d4 + 1 force damage (3d4 + 3 total if all strike one target). Each higher slot creates one additional dart.

spells.name: Magic Mouth
spells.description: You implant a spoken message of up to 25 words in an object, triggered by circumstances you define — a door that warns intruders, a statue that answers a password. The message speaks in your voice when triggered and can repeat.

spells.name: Magic Stone
spells.description: You imbue up to three pebbles with magic for a minute. You or an ally can hurl one with a ranged spell attack (60 feet) dealing 1d6 plus your spellcasting modifier in bludgeoning damage.

spells.name: Magic Weapon
spells.description: In 2024 a bonus action with no concentration: a nonmagical weapon you touch becomes magical with a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls for an hour, rising to +2 or +3 in higher slots.

spells.name: Magnify Gravity
spells.description: Dunamancy crushes a 10-foot-radius sphere with multiplied gravity: Constitution save or 2d8 force damage and halved speed until the end of the creature's next turn; half damage on a success. Each higher slot adds 1d8.

spells.name: Major Image
spells.description: You craft a fully sensory illusion — sight, sound, smell, even temperature — of an object, creature, or scene up to a 20-foot cube, and can animate it as an action. Cast with a 6th-level slot or higher, it lasts until dispelled without concentration.

spells.name: Malti's Lightning Spear
spells.description: You hurl an electric projectile at a creature you can see. On a ranged spell attack hit it deals 4d12 lightning damage. Whether or not the attack hits, the spear bursts into lightning in a 15-foot cone from the attacked creature: each creature in the cone, including the target, makes a Constitution save, taking 3d12 lightning damage or half on a success. Higher slots add 1d12 to the cone damage only.

spells.name: Mass Cure Wounds
spells.description: A wave of healing washes over a point you choose: up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere there each regain 5d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points. Each higher-level slot adds 1d8 to the healing.

spells.name: Mass Heal
spells.description: A tide of healing energy restores up to 700 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures within range. It also cures blindness, deafness, and diseases afflicting the recipients.

spells.name: Mass Healing Word
spells.description: A word of restoration spoken over the fray: up to six creatures of your choice that you can see regain 2d4 hit points plus your spellcasting ability modifier. It has no effect on undead or constructs.

spells.name: Mass Polymorph
spells.description: Up to ten creatures you can see are reshaped into beast forms of your choosing, on a failed Wisdom save for the unwilling. Their gear melds into the new shapes, and each keeps its own mind as its body becomes claws, wings, or hooves.

spells.name: Mass Suggestion
spells.description: You suggest a course of activity, in no more than 25 words, to up to twelve creatures that can hear and understand you; it must sound achievable and not obviously harmful. Each target that fails its Wisdom save gains the Charmed condition and pursues the suggestion until it is done or the spell ends; higher-level slots stretch the duration to 10 days, 30 days, or 366 days.

spells.name: Maximilian's Earthen Grasp
spells.description: A hand of compacted soil rises and seizes one creature: Strength save or it takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained, escaping only with a Strength check against your DC. As an action you can squeeze a held target for another 2d6, or move the hand to a new victim.

spells.name: Maze
spells.description: You banish a creature into a labyrinthine demiplane of twisting corridors with no save to resist. Each turn it can spend its action trying to escape with a DC 20 Intelligence check; when the spell ends, the victim pops back to where it vanished.

spells.name: Meld Into Stone
spells.description: You step into a stone surface large enough to hold you and merge with it, hidden from every sense while you listen dimly to the world outside. Wrecking the stone expels you violently, and its total destruction deals you grievous force damage.

spells.name: Melf's Acid Arrow
spells.description: A shimmering green arrow streaks at a target: ranged spell attack for 4d4 acid damage immediately and 2d4 more at the end of its next turn; on a miss, it splashes for half the initial damage and no lingering burn. Each higher slot adds 1d4 to both.

spells.name: Melf's Minute Meteors
spells.description: Six tiny meteors orbit you. As a bonus action you can send one or two streaking to points within 120 feet, where each explodes — creatures within 5 feet make a Dexterity save or take 2d6 fire damage, half on a success. Higher slots conjure more meteors.

spells.name: Mending
spells.description: Your touch knits a single break or tear in an object back together — a snapped chain link, a torn cloak, a cracked key — so long as the damage is no more than a foot in any dimension.

spells.name: Mental Prison
spells.description: You bind a creature in an illusory cell only it can perceive — fire, floating razors, or gnashing maws ringing its space. It takes 5d10 psychic damage whether its Intelligence save succeeds or fails; on a failure it is also Restrained inside the illusion, blind and deaf to the world beyond, and if it moves out of the cell, attacks through it, or reaches through it, it takes 10d10 psychic damage and the spell ends. Creatures immune to being Charmed automatically succeed.

spells.name: Message
spells.description: You point at a creature and whisper a message only it can hear; it can whisper a reply that only you hear. The whisper can pass around corners and through thin barriers, but not through stone, metal, or lead of any real thickness.

spells.name: Meteor Swarm
spells.description: Blazing orbs of fire plummet from the sky to four points you can see, each exploding in a 40-foot sphere. Creatures in the blast take 20d6 fire damage and 20d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed Dexterity save, or half as much on a success; overlapping spheres strike a creature only once.

spells.name: Mighty Fortress
spells.description: A fortress of solid stone rises from the ground at your word — a keep and four turrets staffed by a hundred invisible servants and stocked with food for a hundred guests, its doors opening only to those you name. It stands for 7 days, or forever if you raise it in the same place every week for a year.

spells.name: Mind Blank
spells.description: One creature's mind becomes an unreadable fortress for a day: immune to psychic damage, mind reading, divination, and the charmed condition — proof even against Wish used to pry at its thoughts.

spells.name: Mind Sliver
spells.description: Brought into the PHB in 2024: a disorienting spike of psychic static assails one creature, which makes an Intelligence save or takes 1d6 psychic damage and subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw before the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Mind Spike
spells.description: You drive a spike of psychic energy into one creature's mind: Wisdom save or 3d8 psychic damage (half on a success), and on a failure you always know its location while you concentrate, and it cannot hide or turn invisible from you. Absorbed into the PHB in 2024; each higher slot adds 1d8.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.description: You craft a false sound or a still image no larger than a 5-foot cube — a voice, a crash, a chest, a set of footprints. Creatures can see through it with an Intelligence (Investigation) check, and physical interaction reveals it.

spells.name: Mirage Arcane
spells.description: You rewrite the terrain of an area up to a mile square: the illusion has look, sound, smell, and even texture, so illusory ground can be walked on and illusory obstacles truly block the way. Structures and creatures keep their forms, but the land itself becomes whatever you imagine.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.description: Three illusory duplicates of you shimmer and shift, making you nearly impossible to target cleanly: attacks that would hit you may strike a duplicate instead (each has AC 10 + your Dexterity), and each hit destroys one.

spells.name: Misfortune's Mark
spells.description: As part of casting you make a melee weapon attack against a creature in range, or the spell fails. On a hit it suffers the attack's normal effects and you knot its fate with misfortune: before the start of your next turn, when it makes an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, you may use your reaction to roll 1d4 and subtract it from that roll. At 5th level the attack deals an extra 1d8 force damage, rising to 2d8 at 11th and 3d8 at 17th. Material component: a melee weapon.

spells.name: Mislead
spells.description: You gain the Invisible condition and an illusory double of you appears where you stood, moving and sounding as you direct. At any time you can see and hear through the double instead of yourself.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: Briefly veiled in silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see — the classic bonus-action escape.

spells.name: Modify Memory
spells.description: You reach into the recent past of a creature that fails a Wisdom save: it is Charmed while you spend the spell reciting an altered version of up to 10 minutes of its last day, and it afterward believes the new memory, rationally filling any gaps.

spells.name: Mold Earth
spells.description: You sculpt loose earth: excavate and move a 5-foot cube of dirt, stamp shapes or words into the ground, or turn a patch into difficult terrain (or flatten it) for an hour.

spells.name: Moonbeam
spells.description: A silvery beam of moonlight, 5 feet wide and 40 feet tall, shines down where you point. A creature that enters the beam or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 radiant damage on a failure (half on a success), and shapechangers save at disadvantage and revert. You can move the beam 60 feet as a Magic action.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
spells.description: An invisible, phantom watchdog takes up guard duty for eight hours, barking loudly at strangers who approach and biting intruders you have not welcomed — a melee spell attack dealing 4d8 piercing damage — though only you can see it.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
spells.description: You conjure a shimmering door, 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall, leading to an extradimensional dwelling with a floor plan of your design — up to fifty contiguous 10-foot cubes, furnished and decorated as you choose. A staff of a hundred near-transparent servants attends all who enter, and food enough for a nine-course banquet for a hundred is served. Only you and creatures you designate can enter; you can open or close the door from within 30 feet, and while closed it is imperceptible. When the spell ends, anything left inside is expelled to the unoccupied spaces nearest the entrance.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
spells.description: You secure a cube up to 100 feet on a side with your choice of wards: sound cannot cross its edge, sight through it is dark fog, divination sensors are barred, creatures cannot teleport or plane-shift in or out, or the whole area is simply sealed against entry. Cast daily for a year in the same place, it becomes permanent.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Sword
spells.description: A spectral sword of force appears within range, and as part of the casting you make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it — on a hit it takes 4d12 force damage plus your spellcasting ability modifier. On your later turns you can use a bonus action to move the sword up to 30 feet to a spot you can see and attack again, against the same target or a different one.

spells.name: Motivational Speech
spells.description: Your stirring words rally up to five creatures: each gains 5 temporary hit points, advantage on Wisdom saving throws, and advantage on the first attack roll it makes before the spell ends. Higher slots add more temporary hit points.

spells.name: Move Earth
spells.description: You slowly reshape dirt, sand, or clay in an area up to 40 feet on a side: raise or lower the ground, dig or fill a trench, erect or flatten a wall, each change taking 10 minutes to settle. Stone and structures are untouched, though buildings may collapse if the earth beneath them shifts badly.

spells.name: Nathair's Mischief
spells.description: From Fizban's, in the spirit of the mischievous Nathair Sgiathach: fey trickery fills a 20-foot cube, and each round the effect changes at random — creatures in it may be blinded by illusory butterflies, charmed by phantom treasure, incapacitated with laughter, or slog through phantom molasses, all on Wisdom saves.

spells.name: Negative Energy Flood
spells.description: You send a burst of negative energy flooding into a creature: on a failed Constitution save it takes 5d12 necrotic damage (half on a success), and a Humanoid killed by it rises at the start of your next turn as a zombie under your control. An Undead target is instead empowered, gaining temporary hit points from the surge.

spells.name: Nerve Pinching Kata
spells.description: As part of casting you make an unarmed strike against a creature in range, or the spell fails. On a hit it suffers the attack's normal effects and has a pinched nerve until the end of your next turn; a creature with a pinched nerve takes 1d6 psychic damage when it takes the Dash, Disengage, or Dodge action, and if you hit it with this cantrip while pinched it takes an extra 1d6 psychic damage. Both damages rise to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th, 4d6 at 17th.

spells.name: Nondetection
spells.description: A willing creature or an object you touch is wiped from magical sight: it cannot be targeted by divination spells or perceived through scrying sensors for the duration.

spells.name: Nystul's Magic Aura
spells.description: You place a false magical face on a creature or object for 24 hours: change or mask its aura against detection spells, or make spells and effects treat it as a different creature type. Cast it daily for 30 days and it becomes permanent.

spells.name: Oath-sealing Covenant
spells.description: When two creatures make a promise to one another, you seal it with magic and a prayer using two rings. If either creature breaks the promise, the other immediately knows it has been broken and the spell ends. If the spell ends as the result of another spell, both creatures become aware of that fact. Scholar access for the Scholar class itself comes via the Seal Agreement erudite application (Diplomat), not via this classes array.

spells.name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
spells.description: A frigid globe explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere: each creature makes a Constitution save, taking 10d6 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. It freezes surface water deep enough to trap swimmers in the ice (Restrained until they break free), and you may instead hold the globe as a cool sling bullet that keeps its power for 1 minute. Upcasting adds 1d6 damage.

spells.name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
spells.description: A shimmering sphere of force engulfs a Large or smaller creature that fails a Dexterity save: nothing passes in or out, the prisoner can take no damage, and the weightless globe can be rolled along — a perfect cage or a perfect shield.

spells.name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
spells.description: One creature you can see within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw or fall into a comic dance. On a failure it gains the Charmed condition for the duration: it must spend all its movement dancing in place, has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and attack rolls, and attacks against it have advantage — though on each of its turns it can spend its action to collect itself and repeat the save, ending the spell on a success. Even on a successful first save it dances until the end of its next turn, spending all its movement in place.

spells.name: Pass Without Trace
spells.description: A veil of shadows and silence wraps you and companions you choose within 30 feet: each gains +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and cannot be tracked except by magic, leaving no prints or scent.

spells.name: Passwall
spells.description: A passage appears in a wooden, plaster, or stone surface you can see: 5 feet wide, 8 feet tall, and up to 20 feet deep, with no damage to the surrounding structure. When the spell ends, the opening closes and anything still inside is shunted to the nearest open space.

spells.name: Phantasmal Force
spells.description: You craft a phantasm in one creature's mind — a creature, fire, a collapsing bridge no bigger than a 10-foot cube — that it alone perceives and rationalizes as real. On a failed Intelligence save it takes 2d8 psychic damage each round from the illusion (doubled in 2024) and can disbelieve only with an Investigation check; the 2024 version can even grip undead and constructs.

spells.name: Phantasmal Killer
spells.description: You conjure a creature's deepest fear into its mind alone: on a failed Wisdom save it takes 4d10 psychic damage and reels with disadvantage on attacks and checks, saving again at the end of each turn — taking the damage once more on a failure, or half damage and freedom on a success.

spells.name: Phantom Steed
spells.description: A quasi-real, horselike creature coalesces to carry you or a rider you choose at a swift 100 feet per round. When the spell ends or the steed is struck, it fades away over a minute rather than vanishing at once.

spells.name: Planar Ally
spells.description: You beseech a god, demon prince, or other cosmic power, which sends a Celestial, Elemental, or Fiend in its service. The creature is under no compulsion: you must bargain and pay for its service (roughly 100 gp per minute of task, 1,000 gp per hour, or 10,000 gp per day), and it departs when the task is done or the agreed time expires.

spells.name: Planar Binding
spells.description: You bind a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend to your service: it makes a Charisma save, and on a failure it must obey your instructions for the duration (a creature summoned by another spell must already be present when you begin). Higher-level slots stretch the binding to days, weeks, or half a year.

spells.name: Plane Shift
spells.description: Holding a forked metal rod attuned to your destination, you and up to eight linked companions vanish to another plane of existence, arriving near the place you named. Used offensively with a melee spell attack, it can banish a single unwilling creature to a plane of your choosing on a failed Charisma save.

spells.name: Plant Growth
spells.description: Plants in a 100-foot radius erupt into thick overgrowth that makes the ground difficult terrain. Or, with eight hours of casting, you enrich the land for a mile around, doubling the year's harvest.

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.description: Reworked in 2024: now Necromancy with a 30-foot range, you project a puff of noxious gas with a ranged spell attack instead of forcing a save. On a hit the target takes 1d12 poison damage, scaling at higher levels.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.description: You rewrite a creature's form into that of a beast no mightier than the target itself — an unwilling target resists with a Wisdom save. The new shape's hit points become temporary hit points over the old form, and when they are gone, so is the beast.

spells.name: Power Word Fortify
spells.description: A single word of power, newly added in the 2024 handbook, that wraps allies in protective magic. You bestow 120 temporary hit points divided as you choose among up to six creatures you can see.

spells.name: Power Word Heal
spells.description: A word of restoration that lets a creature spend its reaction to stand and restores it to full hit points. It also lifts the charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, and stunned conditions and knocks prone targets back onto their feet.

spells.name: Power Word Kill
spells.description: You speak the word that ends life. A creature you can see with 100 hit points or fewer dies instantly — no attack roll, no saving throw.

spells.name: Power Word Pain
spells.description: A word of power inflicts crippling pain on a creature with 100 hit points or fewer — no saving throw. While the pain lasts its speed drops, its attacks, checks, and saves suffer, and casting forces painful Constitution saves to keep concentration, until it shakes the effect off at the end of its turns.

spells.name: Power Word Stun
spells.description: A word of power overwhelms the mind of a creature with 150 hit points or fewer, stunning it outright with no saving throw. At the end of each of its turns it makes a Constitution save to shake off the stun.

spells.name: Prayer Of Healing
spells.description: A 10-minute prayer restores up to five creatures: in 2024 each regains 2d8 hit points (no modifier added) and also gains the benefit of a short rest. Each higher slot adds 1d8 healing.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.description: The classic bag of minor wonders: light or snuff a candle, clean or soil an object, chill or flavor food, conjure a harmless sensory effect or a tiny trinket. Up to three such effects can run at once.

spells.name: Primal Savagery
spells.description: Your teeth and nails briefly become fangs and claws for a melee spell attack that deals 1d10 acid damage. The damage grows at higher levels.

spells.name: Primordial Ward
spells.description: Elemental forces sheath you in protection: you have resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage. When you take damage of one of those types you can use your reaction to become immune to it until the start of your next turn, though the ward then stops resisting the other types until your next turn as well.

spells.name: Prismatic Spray
spells.description: Eight dazzling rays of colored light fan from your hand across a 60-foot cone. Each creature rolls to learn its fate: most rays deal 10d6 damage of an element (fire, acid, lightning, poison, or cold) on a failed Dexterity save, while the indigo ray restrains and slowly petrifies, and the violet ray blinds or hurls the victim to another plane.

spells.name: Prismatic Wall
spells.description: A shimmering wall of seven colored layers, each a different peril and each banishing certain effects: fire, acid, lightning, poison, petrification, madness, and banishment to other planes. Passing through means weathering every layer, and each layer must be destroyed in order by its opposing magic.

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.description: A flame blooms in your hand, shedding light like a torch. In 2024 you conjure it with a bonus action and can hurl it with an action as a ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 fire damage; the damage grows at higher levels.

spells.name: Programmed Illusion
spells.description: You create an illusory scene — an object, creature, or other phenomenon no larger than a 30-foot cube — that lies dormant and invisible until a trigger you define occurs, then performs a scripted routine of sight and sound for up to 5 minutes before going dormant again for 10 minutes.

spells.name: Project Image
spells.description: You project a lifelike illusory double of yourself to any place you have seen, however distant, and see and hear through its senses. The image mimics your voice and manner perfectly but is intangible, vanishing if it takes any damage.

spells.name: Protection From Energy
spells.description: A willing creature you touch gains resistance to one damage type you choose — acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder — for the duration.

spells.name: Protection From Evil And Good
spells.description: One willing creature is warded against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead: such creatures attack it at disadvantage, and it cannot be charmed, frightened, or possessed by them.

spells.name: Protection From Poison
spells.description: You touch a creature and purge one poison from it; for an hour it has advantage on saves against being poisoned and resistance to poison damage.

spells.name: Psychic Scream
spells.description: You unleash an inaudible psychic scream into the minds of up to ten creatures: each makes an Intelligence save or takes 14d6 psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. Creatures too dim to comprehend are immune; those slain by the scream die spectacularly.

spells.name: Pulse Wave
spells.description: A wave of dunamantic force rolls out in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in it makes a Constitution save, taking 6d6 force damage on a failure — and being pushed 15 feet away or pulled 15 feet closer, as you choose for each — or half damage and its footing on a success.

spells.name: Purify Food And Drink
spells.description: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere is purified, rendered free of poison and disease — a ritual that makes suspect rations safe.

spells.name: Pyrotechnics
spells.description: Absorbed into the PHB in 2024: you target an open flame and make it burst — either as blinding fireworks (creatures within 10 feet make Constitution saves or are blinded until the end of their next turn) or as a thick smoke cloud that heavily obscures a 20-foot sphere.

spells.name: Raise Dead
spells.description: You call back the willing soul of a creature dead no longer than 10 days, closing its mortal wounds as it returns to life with 1 hit point. Coming back is an ordeal: the restored creature takes a -4 penalty to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks that shrinks by 1 after each long rest.

spells.name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
spells.description: You weave a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures in range. For the duration they can communicate telepathically with one another through the bond, no matter the distance, as long as they remain on the same plane.

spells.name: Raulothim's Psychic Lance
spells.description: A shimmering lance of psychic power springs from your forehead — or speak a creature's name and the lance hunts it past cover and invisibility alike. The target makes an Intelligence save, taking 7d6 psychic damage and being incapacitated until the start of your next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success.

spells.name: Ravenous Void
spells.description: A dunamantic milestone: a 20-foot sphere of absolute void that crushes light and matter alike. Creatures within 100 feet are dragged toward it on a failed Strength save; those caught inside are restrained and take 5d10 force damage each turn as the void gnaws at them.

spells.name: Ray Of Enfeeblement
spells.description: In 2024 a black beam forces a Constitution save instead of an attack roll: on a failure the creature is weakened — its Strength-based attack damage is halved and it has disadvantage on Strength checks and saves — repeating the save at the end of each turn.

spells.name: Ray Of Frost
spells.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light strikes on a ranged spell attack for 1d8 cold damage, and the chill slows the target, reducing its speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Ray Of Sickness
spells.description: A ray of sickening greenish energy: ranged spell attack for 2d8 poison damage, and on a hit the target makes a Constitution save or is poisoned until the end of your next turn. Each higher slot adds 1d8.

spells.name: Reality Break
spells.description: You tear open the seams of reality around one creature: it takes 10d12 psychic damage on a failed Wisdom save and is wracked each round by a random rupture — blinded, deafened, stunned, or dragged through the breach — until it saves at the end of a turn. Even a successful first save deals half damage.

spells.name: Regenerate
spells.description: Your touch floods a creature with renewing life: it regains 4d8 + 15 hit points at once, then 1 hit point at the start of every turn for the hour. Severed limbs and organs regrow within minutes, and even a detached part held to the stump reattaches.

spells.name: Reincarnate
spells.description: You touch a Humanoid dead no longer than 10 days and call its soul back into a brand-new adult body grown from rare oils and unguents. The new body is of a species determined by rolling on the spell table, and the soul must be free and willing to return.

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.description: At your touch, every curse afflicting a creature or object breaks and ends. A cursed magic item stays cursed in itself, but its owner is freed from the curse and can let go of it.

spells.name: Resistance
spells.description: Reworked in 2024: when you cast it you choose a damage type, and while you concentrate, whenever the touched creature takes damage of that type, the damage is reduced by 1d4.

spells.name: Resurrection
spells.description: You call the soul of a creature dead no longer than a century back to its body, restoring it to life with full hit points and curing its poisons and mundane diseases. The ordeal is taxing: the revived creature takes mounting penalties that fade over long rests, and casting leaves you weakened until you rest.

spells.name: Reverse Gravity
spells.description: Gravity reverses in a 50-foot cylinder: everything unattached falls upward to the top of the area, taking falling damage when it strikes something, and hangs there until the spell ends and it all crashes down. Creatures who grab a fixed object can hold on with a Dexterity save.

spells.name: Revivify
spells.description: You touch a creature that died within the last minute and, at the cost of diamonds the spell consumes, return it to life with 1 hit point. It cannot restore the dead of old age or replace missing body parts.

spells.name: Rime Strike
spells.description: As part of casting you make a ranged weapon attack against a creature in range, or the spell fails. On a hit it suffers the attack's normal effects and the air around it turns frigid, halving its movement speed until the end of its turn. At 5th level the attack deals an extra 1d8 cold damage, rising to 2d8 at 11th and 3d8 at 17th. Material component: a ranged weapon.

spells.name: Rime's Binding Ice
spells.description: From Fizban's: a burst of freezing ice explodes from you in a 30-foot cone. Constitution save or 3d8 cold damage and the creature is encased in ice, its speed reduced to 0 until it or an ally spends an action breaking it free; half damage on a success.

spells.name: Rope Trick
spells.description: You touch a rope and it climbs into the air, its top opening into an invisible extradimensional space that holds up to eight creatures in perfect safety for an hour. Pull the rope up behind you and the entrance vanishes.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature you can see, which makes a Dexterity save — gaining no benefit from cover — or takes 1d8 radiant damage. The damage increases at higher levels.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.description: You ward a creature for a minute: any attacker must make a Wisdom save or choose a new target (or lose the attack). The ward ends for a creature that attacks, casts a harmful spell, or deals damage.

spells.name: Sapping Sting
spells.description: A dunamancy cantrip that lances a creature with enervating magic: Constitution save or 1d4 necrotic damage and the target falls prone. The damage scales at higher levels.

spells.name: Scatter
spells.description: Up to five creatures you can see are seized by spectral wisps and hurled through space to unoccupied spaces you can see within 120 feet of them. Unwilling creatures resist with a Wisdom saving throw.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.description: Three rays of fire streak at targets of your choice, each a separate ranged spell attack dealing 2d6 fire damage on a hit. Each higher slot creates one additional ray.

spells.name: Scrying
spells.description: You gaze through a crystal ball, mirror, or holy-water font at a creature on your plane: unless it succeeds on a Wisdom save (modified by how well you know it and whether you have a piece of its body), you watch and listen to it and its surroundings through an invisible sensor.

spells.name: Searing Smite
spells.description: Cast as you hit with a weapon: the strike deals an extra 1d6 fire damage and ignites the target, which takes 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it makes a Constitution save (or is doused) to end the flames. Both rolls rise 1d6 per higher slot.

spells.name: See Invisibility
spells.description: For an hour you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane, its denizens appearing ghostly and translucent.

spells.name: Seeming
spells.description: You rewrite how any number of creatures in range look, sound, and feel — clothing, armor, weapons, size, even apparent species. Unwilling creatures resist with a Charisma save, and the illusion is given away by physical interaction or a successful Study action against your spell save DC.

spells.name: Sending
spells.description: You whisper a message of 25 words or fewer directly into the mind of a creature you have met, across any distance — even another plane, though the crossing fails one time in twenty. The recipient hears you, knows you, and may answer in kind at once.

spells.name: Sequester
spells.description: You hide a willing creature or an object beyond all finding: it becomes invisible, undetectable by divination, and — if a creature — falls into a timeless sleep that needs neither food nor air. A condition you set at casting ends the spell early.

spells.name: Shadow Blade
spells.description: You weave gloom into a solid blade of shadow dealing 2d8 psychic damage, with the finesse and thrown properties; it hits harder in dim light or darkness (advantage on the attack), and if you drop it, you can reform it with a bonus action. Its damage grows in slots of 3rd level and above.

spells.name: Shadow Of Moil
spells.description: Flame-like shadows wreath your body, heavily obscuring you and dimming the light around you; you resist radiant damage, and whenever a creature within 10 feet hits you, the shadows lash back for 2d8 necrotic damage.

spells.name: Shape Water
spells.description: You shape water in a 5-foot cube: move it, sculpt it into forms, change its color or opacity, or freeze it solid for an hour — no creatures trapped inside, or the ice gives way.

spells.name: Shapechange
spells.description: You assume the form of any creature of challenge rating 20 or lower that you have seen — dragon, fiend, or giant — gaining its statistics while keeping your mind, and you may transform again as an action whenever you like. Wounds carry between forms only when a form is reduced to 0 hit points.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.description: A sudden ringing noise like a struck bell erupts in a 10-foot sphere: Constitution save or 3d8 thunder damage (half on a success). Creatures of crystal, stone, or metal save at disadvantage, and loose objects take the damage too. Note: warlocks lost this spell in 2024. Each higher slot adds 1d8.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: Cast in reaction to being hit or targeted by Magic Missile: an invisible barrier gives you +5 AC until the start of your next turn — including against the triggering attack — and Magic Missile deals you no damage.

spells.name: Shield Of Faith
spells.description: A shimmering field protects one creature you choose, granting it a +2 bonus to AC while you concentrate, for up to 10 minutes.

spells.name: Shillelagh
spells.description: The club or quarterstaff in your hand is imbued with nature's power: you can use your spellcasting ability for its attacks, and in 2024 its damage becomes force damage with a die that grows as you level.

spells.name: Shining Smite
spells.description: A new smite for 2024, replacing Branding Smite: cast as you hit, your weapon blazes — the target takes an extra 2d6 radiant damage, sheds bright light, and cannot benefit from invisibility; until the spell ends, attacks against it have advantage. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
spells.description: Lightning springs from your hand in a melee spell attack for 1d8 lightning damage, with advantage if the target wears metal armor. A hit also robs the target of its reaction until its next turn.

spells.name: Sickening Radiance
spells.description: A 30-foot sphere of ghastly green light blooms: a creature caught in it when it appears, entering it, or ending its turn there makes a Constitution save or takes 4d10 radiant damage and gains a level of exhaustion. The sickly glow clings to victims even after they escape the light.

spells.name: Silence
spells.description: A 20-foot sphere of absolute silence: no sound can be created in or pass through it, creatures fully inside are immune to thunder damage, and verbal spellcasting is impossible there. Often cast as a ritual against enemy casters.

spells.name: Silent Image
spells.description: You create the image of an object, creature, or phenomenon no larger than a 15-foot cube, and can move it with your action while it stays in range. It has no sound, smell, or substance; interaction or an Investigation check reveals it.

spells.name: Silvery Barbs
spells.description: From Strixhaven, cast in reaction when a creature succeeds on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw: you magically distract it, forcing a reroll and taking the lower result — then grant advantage to another creature of your choice within range.

spells.name: Simulacrum
spells.description: You sculpt a duplicate of a beast or humanoid out of snow or ice and breathe illusory life into it. The simulacrum has half the original's hit points and its abilities but no equipment, obeys you loyally, and cannot regain spell slots or grow stronger.

spells.name: Skill Empowerment
spells.description: You touch a willing creature and deepen its mastery of one skill it is proficient in: for the duration, its proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check made with that skill.

spells.name: Skywrite
spells.description: You shape clouds into letters visible across the countryside — up to ten words that hang in the sky for as long as you concentrate, up to a day. A ritual for messages no one can miss.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description: Fully reworked in 2024: no hit-point pool — each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere makes a Wisdom save or is incapacitated, and repeats the save at the end of its next turn, falling unconscious for the duration on a second failure. Damage or a slap wakes a sleeper early.

spells.name: Sleet Storm
spells.description: Freezing rain and sleet lash a 20-foot-wide, 40-foot-tall cylinder, heavily obscuring it and coating the ground in ice. Creatures in the area when it appears, and those that enter or end their turn there, make a Dexterity save or fall prone and risk losing concentration.

spells.name: Slow
spells.description: You seize the flow of time around up to six creatures in a 40-foot cube that fail a Wisdom save: their speed halves, their AC and Dexterity saves drop, they lose reactions, and each turn they can manage only an action or a bonus action, with spells risking a delayed casting. The save repeats at the end of each turn.

spells.name: Snare
spells.description: You hide a magic trap in a rope circle on the ground. A creature that steps in makes a Dexterity save or is hoisted 3 feet into the air, restrained and upside down, until it or an ally makes a Dexterity check to free it.

spells.name: Snilloc's Snowball Swarm
spells.description: Flurries of magical snowballs erupt in a 5-foot sphere where you point: Dexterity save or 3d6 cold damage (half on a success). Each higher slot adds 1d6.

spells.name: Sorcerous Burst
spells.description: A brand-new 2024 cantrip: you loose a bolt of raw magic of a damage type you choose (acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, psychic, or thunder) with a ranged spell attack for 1d8 damage — and whenever a damage die rolls its maximum, you can roll another and add it.

spells.name: Soul Cage
spells.description: As a Humanoid dies within range, you snatch its soul into a tiny silver cage before it can depart. While the soul is trapped you can draw on it up to six times: steal its life to heal yourself, question it (it must answer truthfully), or bolster one of your own attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws with advantage.

spells.name: Spare The Dying
spells.description: You stabilize a dying creature at range — 15 feet in 2024, growing to 30, 60, and finally 120 feet as you reach higher levels — so it no longer needs death saving throws.

spells.name: Speak With Animals
spells.description: For 10 minutes you can comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts, learning what they have seen and enlisting simple favors — what they tell you is limited by their intelligence and senses. Warlocks gained this spell in 2024.

spells.name: Speak With Dead
spells.description: You grant a corpse the semblance of life to answer up to five questions, though it knows only what it knew in life and owes you no honesty. The spell fails on a body already questioned this way within the past ten days.

spells.name: Speak With Plants
spells.description: Plants in a 30-foot emanation around you wake to limited sentience: you can question them about the past day's passersby and weather, order plant-choked ground to clear or clear ground to tangle, and speak with plant creatures as if you shared a tongue.

spells.name: Spell-shattering Strike
spells.description: As part of casting you make a melee weapon attack against a creature in range, or the spell fails. On a hit it suffers the attack's normal effects, and if it is concentrating on a spell the attack deals an additional 1d8 force damage. At 5th level the attack deals an extra 1d8 force damage and the concentrating-target damage rises to 2d8, both rising by 1d8 at 11th (2d8/3d8) and 17th (3d8/4d8). Material component: a melee weapon.

spells.name: Spellfire Flare
spells.description: New in Heroes of Faerun: you loose a flare of raw spellfire — silver-blue flame drawn straight from the Weave — with a ranged spell attack for 2d10 radiant damage, ignoring half and three-quarters cover. Each higher slot adds another flare.

spells.name: Spellfire Storm
spells.description: A pillar of raw spellfire — 20 feet wide and 20 feet tall, blazing with bright light — sears creatures within it: each makes a Constitution save when caught in it, taking 4d10 radiant damage on a failure or half on a success. Worse for enemy casters, any spell cast inside the pillar must first survive a Constitution save or dissipate uselessly.

spells.name: Spider Climb
spells.description: A willing creature you touch gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed and can walk on walls and ceilings while leaving its hands free.

spells.name: Spike Growth
spells.description: The ground in a 20-foot radius turns camouflaged and treacherous, sprouting hard spikes and thorns: it is difficult terrain, and a creature takes 2d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels through the area.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.description: Protective spirits — angelic, fey, or fiendish as suits your faith — flit around you in a 15-foot emanation. Enemies within move at half speed, and each makes a Wisdom save when caught in the aura, taking 3d8 radiant or necrotic damage (chosen when you cast) on a failure or half on a success.

spells.name: Spirit Of Death
spells.description: You summon a reaper spirit of death itself, marked by a gilded playing card, to harvest your enemies. The spirit shares your initiative, obeys your commands, and its scythe strikes at the thread of life until it is destroyed or the spell ends.

spells.name: Spirit Shroud
spells.description: Spirits of the dead swirl around you, and every attack you land on a creature within 10 feet deals an extra 1d8 damage — radiant, necrotic, or cold, chosen when you cast — while the wound refuses to heal until your next turn. Chosen creatures that start their turns near you are slowed by 10 feet.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.description: A floating weapon of force — often your deity's favored arm — appears and strikes on a melee spell attack for 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier force damage; as a bonus action you can move it 20 feet and strike again. Note: the 2024 version requires concentration. Higher slots raise the damage every two levels.

spells.name: Spore Cloud
spells.description: You exhale a faint cloud of spores at a creature in range. On a failed Constitution save it is affected for the duration: the first time each turn it takes poison damage it takes an additional 2d6 poison damage, and it has disadvantage on saves against poison and disease until the spell ends. Higher slots target one additional creature per slot level above 1st. Material component: a poisonous mushroom.

spells.name: Spray Of Cards
spells.description: From the Book of Many Things: a fan of razor-edged cards sprays from your hand. Each creature in the 15-foot cone makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 force damage on a failure (half on a success) and, on a failure, blinded until the start of your next turn. Each higher slot adds 1d10.

spells.name: Staggering Smite
spells.description: Cast as your weapon connects, the blow lands with concussive psychic force: the target takes an extra 4d6 psychic damage and must make a Wisdom save or reel — disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and no reactions — until the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Starry Wisp
spells.description: A new 2024 cantrip: a mote of starlight streaks at a creature with a ranged spell attack for 1d8 radiant damage, and the target sheds dim light and cannot benefit from invisibility until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Steel Wind Strike
spells.description: You flourish a weapon and vanish, flashing between up to five creatures within 30 feet with a melee spell attack against each; a hit deals 6d10 force damage. You then reappear in an unoccupied space next to one of the targets.

spells.name: Stinking Cloud
spells.description: A 20-foot sphere of nauseating yellow gas rolls into being, heavily obscuring its area. A creature fully inside it at the start of its turn makes a Constitution save or is poisoned until the start of its next turn — retching and reeling, unable to take actions or bonus actions.

spells.name: Stone Shape
spells.description: Stone flows under your touch: a section no more than 5 feet in any dimension becomes a door, a passage, a rough sculpture, or whatever form you mold from it — hinges and latches included, if your craftsmanship allows.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.description: A willing creature's skin hardens to stone at the cost of diamond dust the spell consumes, granting resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage for the duration.

spells.name: Storm Of Vengeance
spells.description: A monstrous storm cloud gathers overhead and unleashes escalating wrath round by round: deafening thunder, acid rain, arcing lightning, pounding hail, and finally freezing winds that scour everything beneath it. Creatures below make Constitution saves against its first fury or are deafened for minutes.

spells.name: Storm Sphere
spells.description: A 20-foot sphere of howling wind rages where you place it: creatures inside it when it appears, and any that end their turn there, make a Strength save or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage. As a bonus action you can hurl its lightning at a creature with a ranged spell attack for 4d6 lightning damage.

spells.name: Storm Step
spells.description: You fly up to 15 feet in any direction as lightning flashes around you. Each creature you move adjacent to during this movement must make a Dexterity save, taking 1d6 lightning damage or half on a success; each creature adjacent to you at the end of the movement must make a Constitution save or take 2d6 thunder damage. If you do not land on a surface at the end, you fall immediately. Higher slots add 15 feet of movement per slot level above 1st. Material component: a small metal rod.

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.description: You suggest a course of activity of up to 25 words, phrased to sound reasonable: Wisdom save or the charmed creature pursues it to the best of its ability — the 2024 wording notably drops the old ban on obviously harmful suggestions. The spell ends if you or allies damage the target.

spells.name: Summon Aberration
spells.description: You call a mind-bending horror into an Aberrant Spirit form — beholderkin, slaad, or star spawn — that fights at your command, sharing your initiative. Its psychic touch can whisper madness, and it endures until destroyed or dismissed.

spells.name: Summon Beast
spells.description: Absorbed into the PHB in 2024: you call a bestial spirit that takes the form of a beast of the land, air, or water. It is friendly, shares your initiative, and fights at your side with attacks that grow stronger in higher slots.

spells.name: Summon Celestial
spells.description: You call forth a Celestial spirit using the Celestial Spirit stat block — a radiant Defender that bolsters allies with temporary hit points, or a bow-wielding Avenger dealing radiant damage. The spirit is friendly, acts after you, and grows stronger with higher-level slots.

spells.name: Summon Construct
spells.description: You summon a Construct Spirit of clay, metal, or stone that fights beside you, sharing your initiative and obeying your commands. Metal bodies sear attackers, stone ones shrug off blows, and all of them can mend themselves between strikes.

spells.name: Summon Draconic Spirit
spells.description: You call forth a Draconic spirit using the Draconic Spirit stat block: it rends with clawed attacks and breathes a cone of energy matching one of its resistances, and you share that resistance while the spell lasts. The spirit is friendly, acts after you, and grows stronger with higher-level slots.

spells.name: Summon Dragon
spells.description: You call forth a Dragon spirit using the Draconic Spirit stat block: it manifests in an unoccupied space you can see within range, fights at your command, and disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends. Cast with a higher-level slot and the slot's level is the spell's level in the stat block.

spells.name: Summon Elemental
spells.description: An Elemental Spirit of air, earth, fire, or water answers your call in a form of that element, sharing your initiative and obeying your commands — amorphous, resilient, and wreathed in its element's harm.

spells.name: Summon Fey
spells.description: You call a fey spirit into a Fey Spirit stat block — mirthful, fuming, or tricksy as you choose — that fights beside you, sharing your initiative and obeying your verbal commands. It vanishes at 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

spells.name: Summon Fiend
spells.description: You call forth a Fiendish spirit using the Fiendish Spirit stat block — a hulking Demon, a sly Devil, or a treacherous Yugoloth. The spirit is friendly, acts after you, and grows stronger with higher-level slots.

spells.name: Summon Greater Demon
spells.description: You summon a demon of challenge rating 5 or lower and roll Charisma against its resistance to bind it to your commands each round. Speak its true name and obedience comes easier — but if your concentration breaks, the demon stays, and it is furious.

spells.name: Summon Lesser Demons
spells.description: You tear open the Abyss and a pack of demons pours through — a roll decides whether two, four, or eight lesser fiends answer. They attack the nearest creatures indiscriminately, and if your concentration breaks they do not vanish: they turn on you.

spells.name: Summon Shadowspawn
spells.description: You summon a shadow spirit in the shape of your dread, fury, or fear — a Shadow Spirit that chills the speed of nearby foes and strikes with necrotic claws. It shares your initiative and obeys your commands until slain or dismissed.

spells.name: Summon Undead
spells.description: You call an undead spirit into an Undead Spirit form — ghostly, putrid, or skeletal — that fights at your command, sharing your initiative. Its touch can poison or frighten, and it endures until destroyed or the spell ends.

spells.name: Sunbeam
spells.description: A mote of brilliant sunlight hovers above you as you loose beams of radiance in 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long lines — one when you cast the spell and more as Magic actions while it lasts. Each creature in a line makes a Constitution save, taking 6d8 radiant damage and the Blinded condition until the start of your next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success.

spells.name: Sunburst
spells.description: Brilliant sunlight explodes across a 60-foot sphere. Every creature in it takes 12d6 radiant damage on a failed Constitution save (half on a success) and is blinded for a minute unless it saves at the end of its turns; oozes and undead save at disadvantage, and all magical darkness in the area is dispelled.

spells.name: Swift Quiver
spells.description: Your quiver becomes a blur: as part of the bonus action used to cast the spell, and as a bonus action on your later turns, you can make two attacks with a weapon that uses ammunition from the quiver, which magically produces an endless supply of nonmagical ammunition for them.

spells.name: Sword Burst
spells.description: A momentary circle of spectral blades whirls around you. Every other creature within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 force damage, scaling at higher levels.

spells.name: Syluné's Viper
spells.description: You take on a serpent's gifts for an hour — a climbing speed, 15 temporary hit points that sustain the spell, and a venomous bite delivered as a spell attack. A creature your bite strikes is poisoned and incapacitated until the start of your next turn, with no save to resist — though poison-immune creatures shrug it off.

spells.name: Symbol
spells.description: You inscribe a hidden glyph of power on a surface or object, choosing its trigger and one dread effect — death (10d10 necrotic damage on a failed Constitution save), discord, fear, hopelessness, insanity, pain, sleep, or stunning. Creatures within 60 feet when it triggers must save or suffer the chosen doom.

spells.name: Synaptic Static
spells.description: You unleash a burst of psychic energy in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Creatures with Intelligence 2 or lower are unaffected; others make an Intelligence save, taking 8d6 psychic damage on a failure or half on a success. A creature that fails also has muddled thoughts for 1 minute, subtracting 1d6 from its attack rolls, ability checks, and concentration saving throws, and repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron
spells.description: You conjure a bubbling cauldron around a gilded ladle, and its liquid takes on the character of a Common or Uncommon potion you choose. Over the next 10 minutes the cauldron yields a number of doses of that potion equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum one), which you can draw out with a bonus action.

spells.name: Tasha's Caustic Brew
spells.description: A stream of acid sprays in a 30-foot line. Creatures that fail a Dexterity save are coated, taking 2d4 acid damage at the start of each of their turns until they spend an action scraping or washing the acid off.

spells.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
spells.description: A creature perceives everything as hilariously funny and collapses: Wisdom save or it falls prone and is incapacitated by laughter, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage (with advantage). Warlocks gained this spell in 2024.

spells.name: Tasha's Mind Whip
spells.description: A lash of psychic energy: Intelligence save or 3d6 psychic damage (half on a success) and, until the end of its next turn, the target cannot take reactions and on its turn can do only one of moving, taking an action, or taking a bonus action. Each higher slot whips one more creature.

spells.name: Tasha's Otherworldly Guise
spells.description: You take on an otherworldly aspect from the Upper Planes (spectral wings, a fly speed of 40 feet, immunity to radiant and necrotic harm and to being Charmed) or the Lower Planes (immunity to fire and poison and to the Poisoned condition) — either way, you can wield weapons using your spellcasting ability while transformed.

spells.name: Telekinesis
spells.description: You move creatures and objects by thought alone, exerting your will when you cast the spell and as a Magic action on later turns. A Huge or smaller creature must succeed on a Strength save or be moved up to 30 feet in any direction and held Restrained in your grip until the end of your next turn; unattended objects move automatically, and you can also manipulate tools, doors, and containers with fine control.

spells.name: Telepathy
spells.description: You open a silent mental channel to any creature you know of, anywhere on the same plane, for a full day. Neither of you needs a shared language; the conversation is as private and effortless as thought itself.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.description: In a word, you and up to eight willing creatures — or one object — vanish and reappear at a destination you name anywhere on the same plane. How well you know the destination decides the risk: a familiar teleportation circle is certain, while a vague description can scatter you or dump you somewhere dangerously similar.

spells.name: Teleportation Circle
spells.description: You inscribe a circle of sigils that links to a permanent teleportation circle whose sequence you know, on your plane or another. A portal opens above the circle for 1 round, and any creature that enters it is whisked instantly to the destination circle.

spells.name: Temple Of The Gods
spells.description: A temple dedicated to your god or philosophy shimmers into being, up to 120 feet on a side, fragrant with incense and barred to all but those you permit. Creature types you oppose — celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead — must make a Charisma save even to enter, and their rolls are hindered while inside. Cast daily for a year, it becomes permanent.

spells.name: Temporal Shunt
spells.description: When a creature you can see casts a spell or makes an attack, you flick it out of the timeline: on a failed Wisdom save the creature vanishes until the end of its next turn and its triggering action is interrupted and wasted. A dunamancy spell of the Chronurgy tradition.

spells.name: Ten Thousand Masks
spells.description: You focus your will on your presence and may make a disguise kit ability check without access to a disguise kit; if you are not proficient with disguise kits, you may add half your proficiency modifier to the check.

spells.name: Tenser's Floating Disk
spells.description: A circular plane of force, 3 feet across, hovers just off the ground and follows you at a distance, carrying up to 500 pounds of cargo like the most loyal of porters. It cannot cross drops deeper than 10 feet.

spells.name: Tenser's Transformation
spells.description: You are flooded with martial might: 50 temporary hit points, advantage on attack rolls with simple and martial weapons, an extra 2d12 force damage on each weapon hit, proficiency in Strength and Constitution saving throws, and the ability to attack twice when you take the Attack action. The price is steep — you cannot cast spells while transformed.

spells.name: Tether Essence
spells.description: Dunamis binds two creatures' essences into one thread. When one tethered creature takes damage or regains hit points, the other shares the same fate in equal measure, so long as they remain within 30 feet of each other; a Constitution save resists the binding.

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.description: Minor divine wonders announce your power: your voice booms, the ground trembles, flames flicker, doors fly open or slam shut, or your eyes change appearance. Up to three effects can run at once.

spells.name: Thorn Whip
spells.description: A whip of thorny vines lashes out in a melee spell attack despite its 30-foot reach, dealing 1d6 piercing damage on a hit and dragging the target up to 10 feet toward you if it is no more than one size larger.

spells.name: Thunder Step
