spells.description: A thunderous boom marks your exit as you teleport to a space you can see within 90 feet, optionally bringing one willing creature beside you. Each creature within 10 feet of where you stood makes a Constitution save or takes 3d10 thunder damage, half on a success.

spells.name: Thunderclap
spells.description: You loose a crack of thunder audible 100 feet away. Every other creature within 5 feet of you makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 thunder damage, scaling at higher levels.

spells.name: Thunderous Smite
spells.description: Cast as you hit with a melee weapon: the strike rings like a thunderclap, dealing an extra 2d6 thunder damage, and the target makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you, audible 300 feet away. Each other creature in a 15-foot cube makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 thunder damage and being pushed 10 feet on a failure, or half damage on a success.

spells.name: Tidal Wave
spells.description: A wall of water — 30 feet long, 10 feet wide, and 10 feet tall — crashes down and drains away. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity save, taking 4d8 bludgeoning damage and being knocked prone on a failure, or half damage and its footing on a success; loose flames are doused.

spells.name: Time Ravage
spells.description: You flood one creature with the accumulated weight of time: on a failed Constitution save it takes 10d12 necrotic damage and ages to within days of its natural death, sickened and frail; even a successful save deals half damage. Only a Wish or Greater Restoration can undo the aging.

spells.name: Time Stop
spells.description: Time halts for everyone but you: you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row while the world stands frozen, free to move, prepare, and reposition — until you affect another creature or anything it wears or carries, and the moment shatters.

spells.name: Tiny Servant
spells.description: An object you touch sprouts arms and legs and scampers off as your tireless servant for eight hours, obeying simple commands and fetching, carrying, and triggering things on your behalf. Higher slots animate more objects at once.

spells.name: Toll The Dead
spells.description: A dolorous bell tolls for one creature, which makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d8 necrotic damage — or 1d12 if it is already missing hit points. Brought into the PHB in 2024; the damage scales at higher levels.

spells.name: Tongues
spells.description: A creature you touch gains the gift of tongues: it speaks and understands any language it hears for the duration, and its words are understood by any creature that knows a language.

spells.name: Transmute Rock
spells.description: You transmute a 40-foot cube of stone: rock becomes thick mud that slows and can swallow creatures, or mud becomes solid rock — creatures caught in hardening mud make a Dexterity save or are Restrained inside the stone until freed by damage or a Strength check.

spells.name: Transport Via Plants
spells.description: You link a Large or larger plant beside you to another plant you have seen or touched, anywhere on the same plane. For 1 round, any creature can step into the first plant and out of the second by spending 5 feet of movement.

spells.name: Tree Stride
spells.description: You step into a living tree and emerge from another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. You can make the hop once per turn, and you always know the approximate location and health of the nearest suitable trees.

spells.name: True Polymorph
spells.description: You transform a creature or object utterly — creature into creature, creature into object, or object into creature — on a failed Wisdom save. If you hold the transformation for the full hour it becomes permanent, until dispelled.

spells.name: True Resurrection
spells.description: The mightiest return: a creature dead for up to two centuries is restored to life with full hit points, even if its body was destroyed or its remains are lost — the spell fashions a new body. All curses, diseases, and poisons are cleansed and lost organs regrown.

spells.name: True Seeing
spells.description: A willing creature you touch sees things as they truly are: it gains Truesight out to 120 feet for the duration, piercing darkness, invisibility, illusions, shapechanging, and the veil of the Ethereal Plane alike.

spells.name: True Strike
spells.description: Fully reworked in 2024: as part of casting, you make one attack with a weapon, using your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls. The damage can be radiant instead of the weapon's normal type, and extra radiant damage is added at higher levels, up to +3d6 at 17th.

spells.name: Tuturis' Venomous Sting
spells.description: You conjure a venom projectile and throw it at a creature you can see. On a ranged spell attack hit it takes 6d12 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of your next turn. Higher slots add 1d12.

spells.name: Ulvi's Enfeebling Poison
spells.description: You create four swirling bolts of toxin and hurl them at targets in range, one target or several. Each bolt needs a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 2d8 poison damage and must make a Constitution save or be poisoned until the end of your next turn. A creature poisoned by this spell deals only half damage with attacks and spells. Higher slots add one bolt per slot level above 4th.

spells.name: Unholy Crusade
spells.description: Unholy power radiates from you in a 30-foot aura that moves with you. While in the aura, each nonhostile creature in it (including you) deals an extra 1d4 necrotic damage when it hits with a weapon attack.

spells.name: Unseen Servant
spells.description: An invisible, mindless force performs simple tasks at your command for an hour — fetching, cleaning, serving, opening unstuck doors — with the strength of a frail servant, ending if it takes any real punishment.

spells.name: Vahli's Frost Sphere
spells.description: You hurl a sphere of freezing energy at a point in range. Each creature within 5 feet of it makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 cold damage and losing all speed until the end of its next turn on a failure, or half damage and no speed loss on a success. Higher slots add 1d8.

spells.name: Vampiric Smite
spells.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before the spell ends, you siphon some of its life force: the attack deals an extra 3d6 necrotic damage and you regain hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. Higher slots add 1d6 per slot level above 3rd.

spells.name: Vampiric Touch
spells.description: Your hand is wreathed in shadow that drinks life: make a melee spell attack to deal 3d6 necrotic damage and regain hit points equal to half of it. You can strike again on each of your turns until the spell ends.

spells.name: Venomous Smite
spells.description: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell, the attack deals an extra 1d6 poison damage and the target must make a Constitution save or be poisoned until the spell ends. As an action the creature may make a Constitution check against your spell save DC to overcome the poison and end the spell.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.description: A string of magically laced insults: the target makes a Wisdom save or takes psychic damage (1d6 in 2024) and has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Vitriolic Sphere
spells.description: A glob of caustic acid bursts in a 20-foot sphere: each creature makes a Dexterity save, taking 4d10 acid damage on a failure or half on a success — and those who failed are burned again for 5d4 acid at the end of their next turn as the vitriol keeps eating.

spells.name: Vortex Dart
spells.description: As part of casting you make a ranged weapon attack against a creature in range, or the spell fails. On a hit it suffers the attack's normal effects, and each Large or smaller creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a Strength save or be pulled to the nearest unoccupied space adjacent to the target. At 5th level the attack deals an extra 1d6 force damage, rising to 2d6 at 11th and 3d6 at 17th. Material component: a ranged weapon.

spells.name: Vortex Warp
spells.description: From Strixhaven: space twists around one creature you can see — willing, or failing a Constitution save — and deposits it in an unoccupied space you choose within range, on the ground or a surface that can hold it.

spells.name: Wall Of Fire
spells.description: A wall of roaring flame springs up — 60 feet long in a line or a 20-foot ring — opaque and searing on one side of your choosing. Creatures on the hot side when it appears, or that enter it or end their turn within 10 feet of it, make a Dexterity save or take 5d8 fire damage, half on a success.

spells.name: Wall Of Force
spells.description: An invisible wall of force springs into existence — ten 10-foot panels, a 10-foot-radius sphere, or a hemisphere — immune to all damage and impassable to creatures, objects, and spell effects alike. Only disintegrate destroys it outright.

spells.name: Wall Of Ice
spells.description: A wall of ice rises as a dome or in ten 10-foot panels, each with AC 12 and 30 hit points. A creature whose space the wall cuts through is shoved aside and makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d6 cold damage on a failure or half on a success; a breached section leaves frigid air that deals 5d6 cold damage on a failed Constitution save to creatures passing through. Upcasting adds 2d6 and 1d6 respectively.

spells.name: Wall Of Light
spells.description: A shimmering wall of light, up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high, blazes into being. A creature in its area when it appears makes a Constitution save, taking 4d8 radiant damage and the Blinded condition on a failure (half damage on a success), and the same fate meets creatures that start their turn in the wall — you can also loose beams from the wall as ranged spell attacks for 4d8 radiant damage. Upcasting adds 1d8.

spells.name: Wall Of Pain
spells.description: You create a wall of negative energy on a solid surface in range, up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ring up to 20 feet in diameter with the same height and thickness. The wall is opaque. When it appears, each living creature within its area makes a Constitution save, taking 4d8 necrotic damage and having its speed halved until the end of its next turn on a failure, or half damage and no speed loss on a success. A living creature makes the same save when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there; the far side is harmless. An undead passing through either side gains +10 feet of speed until the end of your next turn. Higher slots add 1d8 per slot level above 5th.

spells.name: Wall Of Sand
spells.description: A 30-foot-long, 10-foot-high wall of swirling sand churns into being. It heavily obscures everything beyond it, the sand itself is difficult terrain, and creatures caught inside it are blinded by the storm of grit.

spells.name: Wall Of Stone
spells.description: A solid wall of nonmagical stone rises in ten 10-foot panels; a creature in the space where the wall appears can make a Dexterity save to escape to one side instead of being trapped. The wall has AC 15 and hit points by thickness, and if you hold concentration for the full duration it becomes permanent and undispellable.

spells.name: Wall Of Thorns
spells.description: A wall of tangled, needle-thorned brush blocks sight and passage: creatures in its area when it appears make a Dexterity save, taking 7d8 piercing damage on a failure or half on a success. Forcing through costs 4 feet of movement per foot, and the first time a creature enters the wall or ends its turn there it makes the save again against 7d8 slashing damage. Upcasting adds 1d8 to both.

spells.name: Wall Of Water
spells.description: A shimmering wall of water rises where you will it — straight, domed, or ringed. Ranged attacks passing through it falter, fire damage crossing it is halved, and cold can freeze a section of it solid.

spells.name: Wardaway
spells.description: New in Heroes of Faerun: a shimmering knot of force strikes one creature, which makes a Constitution save or takes 2d4 force damage and is hampered until the end of its next turn — its speed is halved, and it can take either an action or a bonus action, not both.

spells.name: Warden's Rebuke
spells.description: As part of casting you make a melee weapon attack against a creature in range, or the spell fails. On a hit it suffers the attack's normal effects and the earth quakes threateningly beneath its feet until the start of your next turn; if it willingly attacks a creature other than you before then, it immediately takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage as the earth rises to rebuke it, ending the spell. At 5th level the attack deals an extra 1d6 damage and the rebuke damage rises to 2d6, both rising by 1d6 at 11th (2d6/3d6) and 17th (3d6/4d6). Material component: a melee weapon. (The type of the attack's extra damage is not stated in the source.)

spells.name: Warding Bond
spells.description: You and a willing creature, each wearing one of a pair of platinum rings, are mystically linked: it gains +1 AC and saving throws and resistance to all damage — and every point of damage it takes, you take too.

spells.name: Warding Wind
spells.description: A strong wind roars around you, deafening you and everyone within 10 feet, guttering flames and dispersing vapors. The area within 10 feet is difficult terrain for others, and ranged weapon attacks passing through it have disadvantage.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.description: Up to ten willing creatures gain the ability to breathe underwater for a full day, while keeping their normal breathing as well.

spells.name: Water Walk
spells.description: Up to ten willing creatures treat any liquid surface — water, acid, mud, snow, even lava — as solid ground for an hour. A submerged target is buoyed gently to the surface, though standing on lava still burns.

spells.name: Watery Sphere
spells.description: A 10-foot sphere of water rolls where you direct it, engulfing creatures in its path: those caught make a Strength save or are restrained inside it, carried along as the sphere moves, until they struggle free.

spells.name: Weakening Aura
spells.description: You create an aura of negative energy that weakens nearby life force. Creatures within 15 feet of you cannot regain hit points and have disadvantage on death saving throws, saves against exhaustion, and saves against effects that would reduce their hit point maximum. On each of your turns before the spell ends you may use a bonus action to temporarily disable the field until the start of your next turn. (Note: the printed range line says 30 feet; the effect radius printed in the body is 15 feet — recorded as printed, not reconciled.)

spells.name: Web
spells.description: Thick, sticky webbing fills a 20-foot cube, lightly obscuring it and making difficult terrain. Creatures starting there or entering make Dexterity saves or are restrained until they break free with a Strength check; the webs are flammable and burn away in moments.

spells.name: Weird
spells.description: You conjure each victim's deepest nightmare into its mind. Creatures you choose in a 30-foot sphere make a Wisdom save or take 10d10 psychic damage and are frightened (half damage on a success), suffering 5d10 more at the end of each turn until a save frees them.

spells.name: Whirlwind
spells.description: A howling whirlwind 10 feet wide and 30 feet tall tears across the ground where you direct it. Creatures caught in it take 10d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed Dexterity save (half on a success) and can be hurled bodily into the vortex and flung out at random.

spells.name: Wind Walk
spells.description: You and up to ten willing creatures dissolve into wisps of cloud: in this form you fly at 300 feet, resist damage from mundane blows, and can take only the Dash action or begin the slow, stunning minute of reverting to flesh — which you can later reverse to take to the sky again.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.description: A wall of rushing wind 50 feet long and 15 feet high springs up where you choose. Arrows and small flying creatures cannot pass it, gases and vapors are blown aside, and loose material is hurled about within it.

spells.name: Wish
spells.description: The mightiest spell a mortal can cast: simply speaking reshapes reality. Its safest use duplicates any spell of 8th level or lower without components, but it can also heal a whole company, grant resistances, undo a recent moment, or attempt anything at all — at the risk of warping beyond intent and possibly burning the magic out of you forever.

spells.name: Witch Bolt
spells.description: A beam of crackling energy tethers you to a target on a ranged spell attack hit for 1d12 lightning damage, and in 2024 you can use a bonus action on later turns to deal the damage again automatically. Each higher slot adds 1d12 to the initial damage.

spells.name: Wither And Bloom
spells.description: From Strixhaven, life and death in one breath: each creature of your choice in a 10-foot sphere makes a Constitution save, taking 2d6 necrotic damage on a failure (half on a success), while one ally in the area may spend and roll a Hit Die to heal. Each higher slot adds 1d6 damage and another available Hit Die.

spells.name: Wither Limb
spells.description: Choose a creature you can see in range to make a Constitution save. On a failed save you choose to wither one of its limbs or appendages, preventing it from using that limb for the duration. (Full mechanical detail of the withered limb was interleaved in the extract; the build step must re-read the source PDF before wiring an engine effect.)

spells.name: Word Of Radiance
spells.description: Burning radiance flashes out from you in every direction. Each creature of your choice within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 radiant damage, scaling at higher levels.

spells.name: Word Of Recall
spells.description: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet vanish and reappear at your sanctuary — a place, such as a temple, that you designated by casting this spell there. Without a prepared sanctuary, the spell fails.

spells.name: Wrath Of Nature
spells.description: The terrain in a 40-foot cube comes alive against your enemies: trees lash with their branches (Strength save or 4d6 bludgeoning damage and Restrained by roots and vines), the ground turns treacherous underfoot, and loose rocks pelt creatures that move through open ground (Dexterity save or 4d6 bludgeoning damage).

spells.name: Wrathful Smite
spells.description: Reworked in 2024 (now Necromancy): cast as you hit, the strike deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage and the target makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you until it gathers its nerve with a Wisdom check as an action. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

spells.name: Wristpocket
spells.description: A dunamancy convenience: you vanish an object you are holding (up to 5 pounds) into an extradimensional pocket, and can retrieve it at will while you concentrate. Anything still pocketed when the spell ends reappears in your hand.

spells.name: Yolande's Regal Presence
spells.description: You surround yourself with unearthly majesty in a 10-foot emanation. When the emanation reaches a creature you can see, when a creature enters it, or when one ends its turn there, you can force a Wisdom save: on a failure the creature takes 4d6 psychic damage, gains the Prone condition, and can be pushed up to 10 feet away; on a success it takes half damage only. Upcasting adds 2d6 damage.

spells.name: Zephyr Strike
spells.description: Wind wraps you like a cloak: your movement provokes no opportunity attacks, and once before the spell ends you can give one weapon attack advantage — on a hit it deals an extra 1d8 force damage and your speed rises by 30 feet that turn.

spells.name: Zone Of Truth
spells.description: A 15-foot sphere compels honesty: a creature entering or starting its turn there makes a Charisma save (you know who succeeds) or cannot speak a deliberate lie while in the area — evasive answers remain possible.
